EXO 10:27 Now the Lord had suffered the heart of Pharao to continue stubborn so that he would not let the people go,
EXO 10:28 therefore Pharao said, Begone from me. Take heed to thyself not to see my face any more. For the day thou appearest before me thou shalt die.
EXO 10:29 Whereupon Moses said, Thou hast spoken. I will not appear again in thy presence.
EXO 11:1 Now the Lord had spoken to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt and said, I will inflict yet one stroke more on Pharao and on Egypt and after that he will send you away from his country. And when he shall send you away he will drive you out altogether in haste.
EXO 11:2 Speak therefore privately to the ears of the people, and let every one ask of his neighbour vessels of silver and gold and raiment.
EXO 11:3 And the Lord had given his people favour in the sight of the Egyptians and they supplied them. The man Moses also was become very great in the sight of the Egyptians and in the sight of Pharao, and in the eyes of his attendants,
EXO 11:4 therefore Moses said, Thus saith the Lord, About midnight I will go into the midst of Egypt,
EXO 11:5 and every first born in the land of Egypt shall die: from the first born of Pharao who sitteth on the throne, to the first born of the female slave who is at the grinding mill, including also the first born of all the cattle.
EXO 11:6 And there shall be a great cry through all the land of Egypt; such as hath never been, nor shall the like be again any more.
EXO 11:7 But among all the children of Israel and their cattle not even a dog shall bark at man or beast, that thou mayst know what a distinction the Lord will make between the Egyptians and the Israelites.
EXO 11:8 And all these thy servants will come down to me and make obeisance to me and say, Go away thou and all thy people whom thou wouldst take with thee. Then Moses went out from Pharao with indignation
EXO 11:9 and the Lord said to Moses, Pharao will not hearken to you that I may fully compleat my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
EXO 11:10 Though Moses and Aaron had done all those signs and those wonders in the land of Egypt in the presence of Pharao, yet the Lord suffered the heart of Pharao to be stubborn that he hearkened not to send away the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
EXO 12:1 Now the Lord had spoken to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt saying,
EXO 12:2 This month shall he to you the beginning of months. It is the first for you among the months of the year.
EXO 12:3 Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel and say, On the tenth of this month let them take every one a sheep according to the houses of patriarchal families, every one a sheep for a family;
EXO 12:4 and if there be too few in the family to be sufficient for one sheep, let him associate with him his next neighbour. With regard to the number of souls, every one shall collect to him a number sufficient for a sheep.
EXO 12:5 Your sheep shall be without blemish, a male and in its first year. You may take either from the lambs or the kids.
EXO 12:6 And it shall be kept up by you until the fourteenth day of this month. Then the whole multitude of the congregation of the children of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
EXO 12:7 And they shall take some of the blood and put it on the two side posts and on the lintel of the door of the house in which they are to eat it.
EXO 12:8 And that night they shall eat the flesh roasted with fire. They shall also eat unleavened bread with bitter herbs.
EXO 12:9 You shall not eat any of it raw or boiled in water, but only roasted with fire, head and feet and carcase together.
EXO 12:10 Nothing of it shall be left till the morning. And you shall not break a bone of it. And what is left of it till the morning you shall burn with fire.
EXO 12:11 And in this manner you shall eat it. Your loins shall be girded. Your sandals shall be on your feet, and your staves in your hands. And you shall eat it in haste. It is a passover to the Lord.
EXO 12:12 For in that night I will pass through the land of Egypt, and smite all the first born in the land of Egypt, both of man and beast. And upon all the gods of the Egyptians I will execute vengeance. I am the Lord.
EXO 12:13 But the blood shall be to you for a sign on the houses in which you are. And when I see the blood, I will protect you and there shall be no destroying plague among you, when I smite in the land of Egypt.
EXO 12:14 And that day shall be to you for a memorial. And you shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord throughout all your generations. As an everlasting ordinance you shall celebrate it.
EXO 12:15 Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. And from the first day you shall remove all leaven out of your houses. Whoever shall eat leaven from the first to the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from among Israel.
EXO 12:16 And with regard to the first day, it shall be proclaimed holy; and the seventh day shall be holy to you. In them you shall not do any kind of sacrificial service, save that which must be done for every soul. This alone shall be done for you
EXO 12:17 and you shall keep this commandment. For on that day I will lead out your host from the land of Egypt; therefore you shall make the observance of that day an everlasting rite to your generations.
EXO 12:18 Beginning at evening with the fourteenth day of the first month, you shall eat unleavened bread until the evening of the twenty first day.
EXO 12:19 For seven days there must be no leaven found in your houses. Whoever shall eat leavened bread, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation of Israel; whether he be a stranger or born in the land.
EXO 12:20 You shall eat nothing that is leavened. But in all your habitations you must eat unleavened bread.
EXO 12:21 Moses therefore convened the whole senate of the children of Israel and said to them, Go take for yourselves the sheep according to your families and kill the passover;
EXO 12:22 and ye shall take a bunch of hyssop and having dipped it in the blood by the door you shall smear the lintel and the two side posts with some of the blood which is at the door; and none of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.
EXO 12:23 For the Lord will pass by to smite the Egyptians; and when he shall see the blood on the lintel and on the two side posts, the Lord will pass over that door and will not suffer the destroyer to enter into your houses to smite.
EXO 12:24 And this ordinance you shall keep as a rite established for thee and thy children for ever.
EXO 12:25 And when you come to the land which the Lord will give you as he hath spoken, you must keep up this religious service.
EXO 12:26 And if your children say to you, What is the meaning of this religious service?
EXO 12:27 then you shall say to them, It is the sacrifice of the Passover of the Lord; because he passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. Upon which the people bowed down and worshipped;
EXO 12:28 and the Israelites went and did as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.
EXO 12:29 And when they had so done, it came to pass that at midnight the Lord smote all the first born in the land of Egypt, from the first born of Pharao, who sat on the throne to the first born of the captive in the dungeon, and even the first born of all the cattle.
EXO 12:30 Whereupon Pharao arose by night he and all his attendants and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in all the land of Egypt; for there was not a family in which there was not one dead.
EXO 12:31 And Pharao called for Moses and Aaron by night and said to them, Arise and depart from among my people, both you and the Israelites. Go and serve the Lord your God as you say.
EXO 12:32 Take your flocks and your herds and go away, and bless me, I beseech you.
EXO 12:33 And the Egyptians pressed the people with great earnestness to hurry them away out of the country; for they said, We shall all die.
EXO 12:34 So the people took up, upon their shoulders, their dough which had not yet been leavened: the masses of mixed up meal, bound up in their mantles
EXO 12:35 now the Israelites had done as Moses commanded them; they had asked of the Egyptian gold and silver vessels and raiment,
EXO 12:36 and the Lord had given his people favour in the sight of the Egyptians and they had supplied them, so they spoiled the Egyptians
EXO 12:37 and the Israelites to the number of six hundred thousand men on foot besides women and children began their march from Ramesses to Succoth.
EXO 12:38 And there went up with them a mixed multitude with flocks and herds and cattle in great abundance.
EXO 12:39 And of the dough which they brought out of Egypt they baked unleavened cakes, for it had not been leavened: for the Egyptians hurried them away and they could not wait, and they had not dressed any provisions for themselves for the journey.
EXO 12:40 Now the sojourning of the Israelites which they and their fathers had sojourned in the land of Egypt and in the land of Chanaan was four hundred and thirty years.
EXO 12:41 And at the end of four hundred and thirty years all the host of the Lord came out of the land of Egypt.
EXO 12:42 At night there was a watch for the Lord. This watch of the Lord was instituted that very night to bring them out of the land of Egypt. That it might be kept by all the children of Israel throughout their generations,
EXO 12:43 the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, This is the law of the Passover; No stranger shall eat of it;
EXO 12:44 but every servant born at home or bought with money thou shalt circumcise and then he may eat of it.
EXO 12:45 A sojourner or a hireling shall not eat of it.
EXO 12:46 In one family it shall be eaten, and you must not carry any of the flesh abroad out of the house; nor shall you break a bone thereof.
EXO 12:47 All the congregation of the children of Israel shall keep this festival.
EXO 12:48 And if any proselyte come to you to keep the passover to the Lord, thou shalt circumcise all his males and then he may come and keep it, and he shall be as a native of the land. No uncircumcised person shall eat of it.
EXO 12:49 There shall be one law for the home born and for the proselyte who shall come among you.
EXO 12:50 Now the children of Israel had done as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron; and when they had done so,
EXO 12:51 on that very day the Lord led the Israelites out of the land of Egypt with their host.
EXO 13:1 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 13:2 Consecrate to me every first born. Every first born among the children of Israel, whether man or beast, is mine.
EXO 13:3 Therefore Moses said to the people, Remember this day, in which you came out from the land of Egypt; from the house of bondage. For with a strong hand the Lord hath brought you out from this place; and let no leaven be eaten,
EXO 13:4 for on this day you are marching out in the month of new things.
EXO 13:5 And when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land of the Chananites and the Chettites and the Amorites, and the Evites and the Jebusites and the Gergasites and the Pherezites which the Lord with an oath promised to thy fathers that he would give thee; a land flowing with milk and honey, thou shalt perform this religious service in this month.
EXO 13:6 Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a festival to the Lord.
EXO 13:7 Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. Nothing that is leavened shall be seen with thee; nor shalt thou have leaven in all thy borders.
EXO 13:8 And on that day thou shalt tell thy son and say, This is on the account of what the Lord God did for me, when I came out of Egypt.
EXO 13:9 And it shall be to thee for a sign on thy hand and for a memorial before thy eyes, that the law of the Lord may be in thy mouth; for with a strong hand the Lord thy God hath brought thee out of Egypt;
EXO 13:10 therefore you shall observe this law in revolving seasons from year to year.
EXO 13:11 And when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land of the Chananites, as he sware to thy fathers, and shall give it to thee,
EXO 13:12 thou shalt set apart every first born; all the males for the Lord. Every firstling of the kine or among the cattle which thou mayst have, even all the males thou shalt consecrate to the Lord.
EXO 13:13 Every firstling of an ass thou shalt exchange for a sheep, and if thou wilt not exchange it thou must redeem it. And every male first born of thy children thou shalt redeem.
EXO 13:14 And if at any time hereafter, thy son should ask thee saying, What is the meaning of this? thou shalt say to him, Because with a strong hand the Lord brought us out of the land of Egypt; from the house of bondage;
EXO 13:15 and, when Pharao hardened himself against sending us away, the Lord slew every first born in the land of Egypt, both the first born of men and the first born of cattle, therefore I sacrifice all firstlings; all the males to the Lord: and every male first born of my children I must redeem.
EXO 13:16 And it shall be for a sign on thy hand, and immoveably before thy eyes. For with a strong hand the Lord brought thee out of Egypt.
EXO 13:17 Now when Pharao sent away the people, God did not lead them by the way to the land of the Philistines, because it was near. For God said, Perhaps the people will repent when they see war and will return to Egypt:
EXO 13:18 therefore God led the people by a circuitous march to the wilderness; to the Red sea. And in the fifth generation the Israelites went up out of the land of Egypt.
EXO 13:19 And Moses took with him the bones of Joseph. For with an oath he had adjured the Israelites saying, The Lord will assuredly visit you and you shall carry hence my bones with you.
EXO 13:20 And the children of Israel removed from Succoth and encamped at Otham on the edge of the wilderness.
EXO 13:21 And God went before them, by day in a pillar of a cloud to shew them the way, and at night in a pillar of fire.
EXO 13:22 And there was no failure of the pillar of a cloud by day, and of the pillar of fire by night before all the people.
EXO 14:1 Then the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 14:2 Speak to the children of Israel and let them turn and encamp on the ground between Magdolus and the sea, from the sheep cot on the one side to Beelsepphon on the other. In front of these thou shalt encamp by the sea;
EXO 14:3 whereupon Pharao will say to his people, The Israelites have lost their way in the land for the wilderness hath shut them in.
EXO 14:4 And I will make Pharao's heart stout, so that he will pursue them, and I shall be glorified by Pharao and by all his army. And all the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord. Accordingly the Israelites did so.
EXO 14:5 Now when the king of the Egyptians was told that the people had fled, his heart and the heart of his servants were turned against the people. And they said, What is this we have done in sending the Israelites away from serving us?
EXO 14:6 Therefore Pharao equipt his chariots and took all his people with him.
EXO 14:7 And having selected six hundred chosen chariots and all the cavalry of the Egyptians and officers of the highest rank over all
EXO 14:8 for the Lord had emboldened the heart of Pharao king of Egypt and of his attendants: he pursued the Israelites. Though the Israelites had gone out with a high hand,
EXO 14:9 yet the Egyptians pursued them with all the cavalry and the chariots of Pharao. And his horsemen and his army found them encamped by the sea with the sheep cot on one flank and Beelsepphon on the other.
EXO 14:10 And as Pharao approached; the children of Israel raising their eyes saw the Egyptians encamping in their rear and were greatly terrified. And the Israelites cried to the Lord,
EXO 14:11 and said to Moses, Was it because there were no graves in the land of Egypt, that thou hast brought us out to die in the wilderness? Why hast thou dealt thus with us in bringing us out of Egypt?
EXO 14:12 Is not this what we told thee in Egypt saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it was better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in this wilderness.
EXO 14:13 Whereupon Moses said to the people, Take courage; stand still and see the salvation which cometh from the Lord; which he will work for you this day. For in the manner you have seen the Egyptians this day, you shall never see them again any more.
EXO 14:14 The Lord will fight for you. Be ye therefore silent.
EXO 14:15 Now the Lord had said to Moses, Why criest thou to me? Speak to the children of Israel and let them prepare for marching.
EXO 14:16 And lift thou up thy staff and stretch forth thy hand over the sea and divide it, and let the children of Israel go into the midst of the sea as on dry ground.
EXO 14:17 And behold I will embolden the heart of Pharao and of all the Egyptians and they will go in after them. And I shall be glorified by Pharao and by all his army and by his chariots and by his horses.
EXO 14:18 And all the Egyptians shall know, that I am the Lord when I make myself glorious by Pharao and by his chariots and his horses.
EXO 14:19 Now the Angel of the Lord who marched before the camp of the Israelites had removed and went behind them, and the pillar of cloud had removed from the front and taken its station in the rear.
EXO 14:20 And when it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel and had taken its station; there came on a thick darkness and night intervened so that they did not intermix one with the other during that whole night.
EXO 14:21 And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the Lord restrained the sea that whole night with a strong south easterly wind and made the sea dry ground; and the water was cleft asunder.
EXO 14:22 And the Israelites went into the midst of the sea as on dry ground. And the water thereof was a wall on the right and a wall on the left.
EXO 14:23 And the Egyptians pursued and went in after them, even all Pharao's cavalry and his chariots and charioteers, into the midst of the sea.
EXO 14:24 And in the morning watch, the Lord cast a look on the army of the Egyptians with the pillar of fire and cloud, and threw the Egyptian army into confusion,
EXO 14:25 and entangled their chariot wheels and caused them to drag on heavily; whereupon the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
EXO 14:26 Then the Lord said to Moses, Stretch forth thy hand over the sea and bring back the water to its place; and let it overwhelm the Egyptians, their chariots and their horsemen.
EXO 14:27 So Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and about day break the water was brought back to its place. And when the Egyptians were fleeing below the water the Lord shook them off in the midst of the sea;
EXO 14:28 and the water being brought back to its place overwhelmed the chariots and the horsemen and all the host of Pharao who had marched after the Israelites into the sea, so that not one of them was left.
EXO 14:29 But the Israelites marched on dry ground in the midst of the sea, and the water was a wall to them on their right and on their left.
EXO 14:30 Thus did the Lord on that day deliver Israel out of the hand of the Egyptians. And Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the sea shore.
EXO 14:31 And when Israel saw that great hand; what the Lord had done to the Egyptians, the people feared the Lord, and they put confidence in God and in Moses his servant.
EXO 15:1 Then sung Moses and the Israelites this song to God, and spoke saying, Let us sing to the Lord, For he is gloriously exalted; Horse and rider he hath thrown in the sea.
EXO 15:2 He was my help and defence for safety: He is my God, therefore I will praise him; My father's God, therefore I will extol him
EXO 15:3 A Lord crushing battles, his name is The Lord.
EXO 15:4 Pharao's chariots and host he threw in the sea; Chosen bands; Officers of highest rank. They were swallowed up in the Red sea.
EXO 15:5 In the sea, he whelmed them; They sank to the bottom like a stone.
EXO 15:6 Thy right hand, Lord, is glorious in power. Thy right hand, Lord, dashed enemies to pieces.
EXO 15:7 With thy great glory thou didst crush thine adversaries. Thou sentest forth thy wrath; it consumed them like stubble.
EXO 15:8 At the blast of thy wrath the water parted; The waters were compacted like a wall; The waves were condensed in the midst of the sea.
EXO 15:9 The enemy said, I will pursue and overtake, I will divide the spoil; I will glut my vengeance: My sword shall slay; my hand shall prevail.
EXO 15:10 Thou didst send forth thy blast, the sea covered them; They sank like lead in the mighty water.
EXO 15:11 Who among the gods is like thee, Lord? Who is like thee? Glorified among Holies; Marvellous among Glories; working miracles!
EXO 15:12 Thou didst stretch forth thy right hand, The earth swallowed them up,
EXO 15:13 In thy kindness thou hast been the guide Of this thy people whom thou hast redeemed. By thy power thou hast called them forth to thy holy place for resting.
EXO 15:14 Nations have heard and are troubled: Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Phylisteim;
EXO 15:15 The Emirs of Edom are already in commotion; And as for the chiefs of Moab, horror hath seized them: All the inhabitants of Chanaan are appalled.
EXO 15:16 On them let dread and terror fall. By the greatness of thine arm may they be petrified, till thy people pass through, Lord; till this thy people pass by, whom thou hast purchased.
EXO 15:17 Introduce and plant them on the mount of thy heritage in the settlement thou hast prepared for thy dwelling, Lord; The sanctuary, Lord, which thy hands have prepared.
EXO 15:18 The Lord reigneth for ever and for evermore.
EXO 15:19 Because Pharao's cavalry with chariots and charioteers went into the sea, and the Lord brought upon them the water of the sea; and the Israelites marched in the midst of the sea on dry ground;
EXO 15:20 therefore Mariam the prophetess the sister of Aaron took in her hand a timbrel and all the women went out after her with timbrels in choirs,
EXO 15:21 and Mariam led the song for them, saying, Let us sing to the Lord, For he is gloriously exalted: Horse and rider he hath thrown in the sea;
EXO 15:22 Then Moses drew off the Israelites from the Red sea; and led them into the wilderness of Sour, and they marched three days in the wilderness and found no water to drink.
EXO 15:23 And when they came to Merra they could not drink the water there, for it was bitter. Therefore they called the name of that place Bitterness.
EXO 15:24 And the people murmured against Moses and said, What are we to drink?
EXO 15:25 Upon this Moses cried to the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a piece of wood and he threw it into the water, and the water was made sweet. There he instituted for them rules of rectitude and judgments, and there he proved them
EXO 15:26 and said, If thou wilt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and do the things well pleasing in his sight, and hearken to his commandments, and keep all these his rules of rectitude, I will not bring upon thee any of the diseases which I brought on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord thy God who healeth thee.
EXO 15:27 Then they came to Aileim, where there were twelve fountains of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there by the water.
EXO 16:1 And the whole congregation of the children of Israel removed from Aileim and came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Aileim and Sina.
EXO 16:2 And on the fifteenth day of the second month after their coming out of Egypt all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron.
EXO 16:3 The Israelites indeed said to them, Oh that we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of flesh meat and ate bread in plenty! For you have brought us to this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
EXO 16:4 Whereupon the Lord said to Moses, Behold I am going to rain bread from heaven for you. And the people shall go and gather it day by day, that I may try them whether they will walk in my law or not.
EXO 16:5 But on the sixth day they must be provident in respect to what they bring in. It shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
EXO 16:6 Then Moses and Aaron said to all the congregation of the Israelites, In the evening you shall know that the Lord hath brought you out of the land of Egypt,
EXO 16:7 and in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord, by his hearkening to your murmurings against God. As for us, what are we that you should murmur against us?
EXO 16:8 [Now Moses had dictated, by the Lord's giving you in the evening flesh to eat and in the morning bread in plenty, because the Lord hath heard your murmurings which you utter against us. But as for us what are we? your murmuring is not against us but against God.]
EXO 16:9 Then Moses said to Aaron, Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, Attend in the presence of God, for he hath heard your murmuring.
EXO 16:10 And when Aaron had spoken to all the congregation of the Israelites and they had turned about towards the wilderness, the glory of the Lord appeared in a cloud,
EXO 16:11 and the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 16:12 I have heard the murmuring of the Israelites. Speak to them and say, Towards evening you shall eat flesh and in the morning you shall be plentifully supplied with bread. And you shall know that I am the Lord, your God.
EXO 16:13 Accordingly there came up in the evening a flock of quails, which covered the camp, and in the morning while the dew lay around the camp,
EXO 16:14 behold on the face of the wilderness something small like coriander, white like hoar frost, on the ground!
EXO 16:15 And when the Israelites saw this they said one to another, What is this? for they did not know what it was. Upon which Moses said to them. This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat.
EXO 16:16 This is what the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it, every one for his family a gomer a head according to the number of souls, you must every one gather for those in the tent with you.
EXO 16:17 And the children of Israel did so and gathered some more and some less,
EXO 16:18 and when they measured it by the gomer, he who had gathered much had nothing over, and he who had gathered little did not fall short. Every one had gathered sufficient for the family with him.
EXO 16:19 Then Moses said to them, Let none leave any of it till the morning.
EXO 16:20 Notwithstanding this they hearkened not to Moses, but some left of it till the morning. And it bred worms and gave an offensive smell. On which Moses was angry with them.
EXO 16:21 So they gathered it every morning, every one a sufficiency for his family. And when the sun grew warm, it melted away.
EXO 16:22 Now on the sixth day when they were gathering a double quantity, two gomers for every one, all the heads of the congregation came and told Moses,
EXO 16:23 whereupon he said to them, Is not this what the Lord spoke, Sabbaths are a rest holy to the Lord? As for to-morrow, bake what you chuse to bake and boil what you chuse to boil and what is left lay up for to-morrow.
EXO 16:24 So they left some of it till the morning as Moses commanded them and it did not become putrid, nor was there a Worm in it.
EXO 16:25 Then Moses said to them, Eat it to-day, for to 26 day is the Sabbath to the Lord. It will not be found in the field.
EXO 16:26 Six days you shall gather but because the Sabbaths are on the seventh day, therefore in it there will be none.
EXO 16:27 And it came to pass that on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but found none.
EXO 16:28 Whereupon the Lord said to Moses, How long will you refuse to hearken to my commandments and my law?
EXO 16:29 You see that because the Lord gave you this day for sabbaths, therefore on the sixth day he gave you the bread of two days. Abide ye every one at home. Let none go out from his place on the seventh day.
EXO 16:30 So the people rested on the seventh day.
EXO 16:31 Now the Israelites called its name Manna. It was like coriander seed. It was white; and its taste was like a cake made with honey.
EXO 16:32 And Moses said, This is what the Lord hath commanded, Fill the gomer with Manna to be laid up for your posterity, that they may see the bread which you ate in the wilderness, when the Lord brought you out of the land of Egypt.
EXO 16:33 Then Moses said to Aaron, Take a golden urn and put therein the full of a gomer of Manna; and thou shalt lay it up before God to be kept for your posterity.
EXO 16:34 As the Lord commanded Moses so Aaron laid it up before the testimony that it might be kept.
EXO 16:35 And the children of Israel ate this Manna forty years till they came to the inhabited land. They ate it till they came to the border of Phoenicia. Now the gomer is the tenth of the trimeter.
EXO 17:1 When all the congregation of the Israelites had removed from the wilderness of Sin according to their encampments by the command of the Lord and encamped at Raphidin and there was no water for the people to drink,
EXO 17:2 and the people were reviling Moses and saying, Give us water that we may drink, Moses said to them, Why do you revile me? And why do you tempt the Lord?
EXO 17:3 Now when the people had thirsted there for water and murmured against Moses saying, How is this? Hast thou brought us up out of Egypt to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
EXO 17:4 Moses cried to the Lord and said, What shall I do for this people? They are almost ready to stone me.
EXO 17:5 Upon which the Lord said to Moses, Go on at the head of the people, and take thee some of the elders of the people, and take in thy hand the staff with which thou didst smite the river.
EXO 17:6 And thou shalt go to the place where I before caused thee to stand on the rock at Choreb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and water will gush out that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the presence of the Israelites,
EXO 17:7 and he called the name of that place, Temptation and Upbraiding, because of the upbraiding of the Israelites, and because they tempted the Lord and said, Is the Lord among us or not?
EXO 17:8 Now Amalek had come and made war on Israel at Raphidin,
EXO 17:9 upon which Moses said to Joshua, Select for thyself able men and go out and draw up in array to-morrow against Amalek; when lo I have stood on the top of that hill with the staff of God in my hand.
EXO 17:10 So Joshua did as Moses commanded him. And when he had gone out and drawn up in array against Amalek, and Moses and Aaron and Hur had gone up to the top of the hill,
EXO 17:11 it came to pass that when Moses held up his hands Israel prevailed; but when he let down his hands Amalek prevailed.
EXO 17:12 But Moses hands were heavy, therefore they took a stone and put it under him and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, one on one side, and the other, on the other. So his hands were stayed up till the going down of the sun
EXO 17:13 and Joshua discomfited Amalek and his whole people with the slaughter of the sword.
EXO 17:14 Then the Lord said to Moses, Write this in a book to keep it in remembrance; and rehearse it in the hearing of Joshua, that I will entirely blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
EXO 17:15 And Moses built an altar to the Lord and called its name, The Lord my refuge;
EXO 17:16 because with a secret hand the Lord fighteth against Amalek from generation to generation.
EXO 18:1 Now when Jothor the priest of Madiam, Moses' father in law heard of all that the Lord had done for his people Israel, [for while the Lord was bringing Israel out of Egypt
EXO 18:2 Jothor the father in law of Moses had taken home Sepphora, Moses' wife, after she had gone back,
EXO 18:3 with her two sons, of whom the name of one was Gersam; for he said, I was a stranger in a strange land;
EXO 18:4 and the name of the other Eliezar; for the God of my fathers, said he, hath been my help, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Pharao]
EXO 18:5 Jothor the father in law of Moses came out to him with his sons and his wife to the wilderness where he was encamped by the mount of God.
EXO 18:6 And when they told Moses saying, Behold Jothor thy father in law is coming to thee with thy wife and thy two sons with him,
EXO 18:7 Moses went out to meet his father in law and made obeisance to him and kissed him. And when they had embraced each other he conducted them to his tent.
EXO 18:8 And Moses told his father in law all that the Lord had done to Pharao and to all the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the difficulties which they had encountered on the way, and how the Lord had rescued them out of the hand of Pharao and out of the hand of the Egyptians.
EXO 18:9 Whereupon Jothor was enrapt in wonder at all the good things which the Lord had done for them in delivering them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharao;
EXO 18:10 and Jothor said, Blessed be the Lord. Because he hath delivered these out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharao,
EXO 18:11 I know now that the Lord is great above all the gods, for this reason because they were set against these.
EXO 18:12 Then Jothor the father in law of Moses took whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for God; and Aaron and all the elders of Israel came to eat bread before God with Moses' father in law.
EXO 18:13 And on the morrow Moses sat to administer justice to the people, and all the people attended on Moses from early in the morning till late in the evening.
EXO 18:14 And when Jothor saw all that he did for the people, he said, What is this that thou dost for the people? Why hast thou sitten alone and all the people attended thee from morning till night?
EXO 18:15 And Moses said to his father in law, Because the people come to me to have a determination from God.
EXO 18:16 For when a controversy happeneth among them and they come to me, I administer justice to every one, and teach them the statutes of God and his law.
EXO 18:17 Thereupon Moses' father in law said to him, Thou dost not transact this business right.
EXO 18:18 Both thou and this people with thee must needs be worn down by this intolerable service. This business is too fatiguing for thee. Thou canst not perform it thyself alone.
EXO 18:19 Now therefore hearken to me and I will advise thee; and God be with thee. Be thou to the people as the Oracle of God; and lay their cases before God;
EXO 18:20 and testify to them the statutes of God and his law; and point out to them the ways in which they shall walk, and the works which they shall do:
EXO 18:21 but look out for thyself from among all the people, for able, pious men, men of integrity who hate pride; and set these over them as rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, and rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens;
EXO 18:22 and let them administer justice to the people on all occasions: and the matter which is too high for them, they shall lay before thee; but causes easily determined they themselves shall decide. Thus they will remove a burden from thee and help thee.
EXO 18:23 If thou do this God will strengthen thee so that thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall go to their place with peace.
EXO 18:24 So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he said.
EXO 18:25 And when Moses had chosen able men from among all Israel and made them rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, and rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens,
EXO 18:26 with orders to administer justice to the people on all occasions, and that they should lay before him the matter which was too high for them; but the causes easily determined they themselves should decide;
EXO 18:27 then Moses gave his father in law leave to depart and he returned to his own land.
EXO 19:1 Now on the first day of the third month after the departure of the Israelites out of the land of Egypt, on the very day they came to the wilderness of Sina;
EXO 19:2 when they had removed from Raphidin and came to the wilderness of Sina and Israel were encamping there before the mount,
EXO 19:3 Moses went up to the mount of God. And God called to him out of the mount and said, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and announce to the children of Israel;
EXO 19:4 You have seen what I have done to the Egyptians; and how I have taken you up as on the wings of eagles and brought you to myself.
EXO 19:5 Now therefore if you will hearken diligently to my voice and keep my covenant, you shall be to me a peculiar people above all the nations; for the whole earth is mine:
EXO 19:6 but as for you, you shall be a royal priesthood and a holy nation. These words thou shalt deliver to the children of Israel.
EXO 19:7 Upon this Moses came and called the elders of the people and laid before them all these words which God enjoined on them.
EXO 19:8 And all the people with one consent answered and said, All that God hath said we will do and we will be obedient. And Moses carried up these words to God.
EXO 19:9 Then the Lord said to Moses, Behold I will come to thee in a pillar of cloud, that the people may hear me speaking to thee and believe thee for ever.
EXO 19:10 When Moses told the Lord the words of the people the Lord said to Moses, Go down and testify to the people and purify them to-day and to-morrow and let them wash their garments
EXO 19:11 and be ready against the third day; for on the third day the Lord will descend upon mount Sina in the sight of all the people.
EXO 19:12 Therefore thou shalt remove the people to some distance round about and say, Take heed to yourselves not to go up to the mount nor touch any part of it. Whoever shall touch the mount shall surely die.
EXO 19:13 A hand shall not touch him, for he shall be stoned with stones or shot with a dart. Whether man or beast it shall not live. When the voices and the trumpets and the cloud are gone from the mount, they may go up to the mount.
EXO 19:14 So Moses went down from the mount to the people and purified them, and they washed their garments.
EXO 19:15 And he said to the people, Be ready, for three days you must not approach a wife.
EXO 19:16 And it came to pass on the third day that about dawn there were thunders and lightnings and a thick cloud on mount Sina, and the voice of the trumpet sounded loud, so that all the people in the camp were terrified.
EXO 19:17 Then Moses led forth the people out of the camp to meet God, and they halted at the foot of the mount.
EXO 19:18 The whole mountain Sina was enveloped with smoke, because God had descended upon it in fire. And the smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, so that all the people were exceedingly amazed.
EXO 19:19 Still the sounds of the trumpet waxed louder and louder. Moses had spoken and God had answered him by a voice.
EXO 19:20 And the Lord descended upon mount Sina on the summit of the mount, and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount, and Moses went up.
EXO 19:21 And God spoke to Moses saying, Go down and testify to the people; peradventure they may come nigh to God to observe, and a multitude of them may perish.
EXO 19:22 And let the priests who come near to the Lord God be purified, lest peradventure the Lord withdraw from them.
EXO 19:23 And Moses said to God, The people cannot advance to mount Sina; for thou hast testified to us saying, Set apart the mount and hallow it.
EXO 19:24 But the Lord said to him, Away; go down and come up thou and Aaron with thee; but let not the priests nor the people presume to come up to God lest peradventure the Lord destroy some of them.
EXO 19:25 And when Moses had gone down to the people and spoken to them,
EXO 20:1 the Lord spoke all these words saying,
EXO 20:2 I am the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt; out of the house of bondage.
EXO 20:3 Thou shalt have no other gods besides me.
EXO 20:4 Thou shalt not make for thyself an idol, nor the likeness of any thing, which is in the heaven above, or in the earth below, or in the waters under the earth;
EXO 20:5 thou shalt not worship them; nor serve them; for I, the Lord thy God, am a zealous God, retributing to them who hate me the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation;
EXO 20:6 but shewing mercy for thousands [of generations] to them who love me and keep my commandments.
EXO 20:7 Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord thy God will not hold him guiltless who taketh his name in vain.
EXO 20:8 Remember the day of the sabbaths to hallow it.
EXO 20:9 Six days labour and do all thy works;
EXO 20:10 but on the seventh day are sabbaths to the Lord thy God; On it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy man servant, nor thy maid servant, nor thy ox, nor thy ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor the stranger who sojourneth with thee;
EXO 20:11 for in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all that are in them, and rested on the seventh day: therefore the Lord blessed the seventh day and hallowed it.
EXO 20:12 Honour thy father and thy mother that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayst live long in that good land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
EXO 20:13 Thou shalt not commit adultery.
EXO 20:14 Thou shalt not steal.
EXO 20:15 Thou shalt not commit murder.
EXO 20:16 Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
EXO 20:17 Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife; thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, nor his field, nor his man servant, nor his maid servant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any of his cattle, nor any thing belonging to thy neighbour.
EXO 20:18 And all the people looked towards the thunder and the lightnings and the sound of the trumpet and the mount which was smoking; and all the people being struck with terror stood at a distance.
EXO 20:19 And they said to Moses, Speak thou to us: and let not God speak to us lest we die.
EXO 20:20 Whereupon Moses said to them, Take courage; for God is come to you to prove you, that the dread of him may be in you, that you may not sin.
EXO 20:21 Then the people stood afar off, and Moses went into the thick darkness, where God was.
EXO 20:22 And the Lord said to Moses, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob and announce to the children of Israel, You have seen that I have spoken to you from heaven.
EXO 20:23 You shall not make for yourselves gods of silver, nor shall you make for yourselves gods of gold.
EXO 20:24 An altar of earth you shall make for me, and sacrifice thereon your whole burnt offerings and your offerings of thanksgiving, both your sheep and your young bulls in every place where I record my name.
EXO 20:25 And I will come to thee and bless thee. And if thou makest for me an altar of stones; thou shalt not build it of hewn stones: for thou hast put thy workmanship on them and they are polluted.
EXO 20:26 Thou shalt not go up to my altar by steps, that thou mayst not discover thy nakedness on it.
EXO 21:1 And these are the rules of rectitude which thou shalt set before them.
EXO 21:2 If thou purchase a Hebrew servant, he shall serve thee six years, but in the seventh year he shall go out free without ransom.
EXO 21:3 If he came in alone, he shall go out alone; but if his wife came with him his wife shall go out with him.
EXO 21:4 And if his master hath given him a wife and she hath born him sons or daughters, the wife and the children shall belong to his master, and he shall go out alone.
EXO 21:5 And if the servant shall answer and say, I love my master and my wife and my children, I will not go away free,
EXO 21:6 his master shall bring him to God's court of Justice and there lead him to the door; to the door post, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl and he shall serve him for ever.
EXO 21:7 When any man selleth his daughter to be a handmaid she shall not go away as those who are in bondage go.
EXO 21:8 If she please not her master provided he betrothed her for himself, he shall let her be redeemed; but he is not her master to sell her into another family, because he hath broken covenant with her:
EXO 21:9 but if he betroth her for his son, he shall deal by her according to the privilege of daughters.
EXO 21:10 And if the son take another for himself, he shall not deprive her of food and raiment and her marriage rites.
EXO 21:11 And if he do not these three for her she shall go away ransom free.
EXO 21:12 If any one smite another and he die, he shall be put to death.
EXO 21:13 But if he was not a voluntary agent, but God delivered into his hands, I will appoint for thee a place to which he who hath killed shall flee.
EXO 21:14 But if any one lie in wait for his neighbour to kill him insidiously, and flee, thou shalt drag him from my altar to put him to death.
EXO 21:15 He who smiteth his father or his mother shall be put to death.
EXO 21:16 He who stealeth any of the children of Israel, and having got him in his power selleth him, or if he be found with him, shall be put to death.
EXO 21:17 He who curseth his father or his mother shall be put to death.
EXO 21:18 If two men quarrel and one smite the other with a stone or his fist and he dieth not, but is confined to his bed;
EXO 21:19 if the man rise and walk abroad on his staff, he who smote him shall be acquitted but shall pay for his loss of time and the expence of his cure.
EXO 21:20 If a man smite his man servant or his maid servant with a staff; and the servant die under his hand, vengeance shall be taken by a judicial process;
EXO 21:21 but if the servant live a day or two, let no vengeance be taken, for he is his money.
EXO 21:22 If two men fight and strike a woman with child and she miscarry of an embrio, atonement shall be made by a fine. According as the husband of the woman shall with a judicial decision lay upon him, he shall pay:
EXO 21:23 but if the child be compleatly organised he shall give, life for life; eye for eye;
EXO 21:24 tooth for tooth; hand for hand; foot for foot;
EXO 21:25 burning for burning; wound for wound; stripe for stripe.
EXO 21:26 But if a man smite the eye of a man servant, or the eye of a maid servant; and it become blind, he shall set them free for their eye's sake.
EXO 21:27 And if he beat out the tooth of a man servant, or the tooth of a maid servant, he shall set them free for their tooth's sake.
EXO 21:28 If a bull gore a man or a woman and he or she die, the bull shall be stoned to death and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall be held guiltless:
EXO 21:29 but if the bull hath heretofore been accustomed to push with his horns, and this hath been made known to his owner, and he hath not shut him up; if he kill a man or woman, the bull shall be stoned and his owner also may be put to death.
EXO 21:30 But if a fine shall be laid upon him, he shall pay as a ransom for his life whatever they lay upon him.
EXO 21:31 And if the bull shall gore a son or a daughter, they shall deal with him according to this law.
EXO 21:32 But if the bull shall gore a man servant or a maid servant he shall pay their master thirty didrachms of silver and the bull shall be stoned.
EXO 21:33 If any man open a pit, or dig a pit and do not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein,
EXO 21:34 the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall pay the owner of them, and the dead beast shall be his.
EXO 21:35 If any man's bull gore the bull of his neighbour and he die, they shall sell the live bull and divide the money and they shall divide the dead bull.
EXO 21:36 But if the bull be noted for having been heretofore accustomed to push with his horns, and this hath been made known to his owner, and he hath not shut him up he shall be fined bull for bull and the dead bull shall be his.
EXO 22:1 If any man steal an ox or a sheep and kill, or sell it, he shall pay as a fine five oxen for the ox, and four sheep for the sheep.
EXO 22:2 If a thief be found in the act of breaking in and be struck and die, he who struck him is not liable to death;
EXO 22:3 but if the sun was risen upon him he is liable and may be put to death. If a thief hath no property, let him be sold for the theft.
EXO 22:4 If the thing stolen, whatever it be from an ass to a sheep, be left alive and found in his hand, he shall be fined double.
EXO 22:5 If any man cause a field or a vineyard to be eaten and shall send out his cattle to feed upon the field of another, with the produce of his own field he shall make restitution; and if he shall cause a whole field to be eaten up; with his choicest field or his choicest vineyard he shall make compensation.
EXO 22:6 If a fire break out and catch in thorns and consume corn on the threshing floors or on the stalk, or in the field, he who kindled the fire shall make compensation.
EXO 22:7 If any man deliver to his neighbour money or furniture to keep, and they be stolen out of the man's house; the thief, if he be found, shall be fined double.
EXO 22:8 But if the thief cannot be found, the owner of the house shall go before God and be examined on oath whether he may not in some manner have acted wrong touching the deposit of his neighbour.
EXO 22:9 On every supposed act of injustice touching an ox or an ass or a sheep or raiment or any kind of deposit which is lost, whatever it may be, the cause of both parties shall come before God, and he whom God pointeth out shall pay his neighbour two fold.
EXO 22:10 And if a man deliver to his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast to keep, and it be hurt or die, or be carried off by an enemy unknown to any one,
EXO 22:11 there shall be an oath of God between the parties, that he hath not in any manner acted wrong touching the deposit of his neighbour; and the owner shall thus be satisfied; and the other shall not make it good.
EXO 22:12 But if it be stolen from him he shall make restitution to the owner;
EXO 22:13 and if it be torn by wild beasts he shall bring the owner to the prey and shall not make compensation.
EXO 22:14 But if any one borrow of his neighbour and that which was borrowed be hurt or die or be carried off by an enemy and the owner be not with it, he shall make compensation;
EXO 22:15 but if the owner be with it he shall not make it good, and if it be hired he shall have it for the hire of it.
EXO 22:16 If any man delude an unmarried virgin and lie with her, he shall by paying a dowry purchase her for a wife:
EXO 22:17 but if her father absolutely refuse and will not consent to give her to him for a wife, he shall pay the father in money to the amount of the dowry paid for virgins.
EXO 22:18 You shall not protect sorcerers.
EXO 22:19 Every act of bestiality you shall punish with death.
EXO 22:20 He who sacrificeth to any god save to the Lord alone shall be destroyed by death.
EXO 22:21 A stranger you shall not injure; nor shall you afflict him; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
EXO 22:22 A widow and an orphan you shall not afflict.
EXO 22:23 If you in anywise afflict them and they cry to me, I will hear their voice
EXO 22:24 and my wrath will be kindled, and I will slay you with the sword, and your wives shall be widows and your children fatherless.
EXO 22:25 If thou lend money to thy brother, who is near thee and in want; thou shalt not be rigorous with him, nor charge him interest.
EXO 22:26 And if thou hast taken the mantle of thy neighbour as a pledge, thou shalt restore it to him before the setting of the sun;
EXO 22:27 for it is his covering. This mantle is the only covering of his nakedness. In what can he sleep? If therefore he cry to me, I will hear him; for I am merciful.
EXO 22:28 Thou shalt not revile gods, nor speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
EXO 22:29 The first fruits of thy threshing floor and of thy press thou shalt not withhold. The first born of thy sons thou shalt give to me.
EXO 22:30 Thou shalt do the same with thy calf, thy sheep and thy ass. Seven days it shall be with the dam and on the eighth day thou shalt dedicate it to me.
EXO 22:31 You shall be men holy to me, and you shall not eat what is torn by wild beasts. You shall throw it to the dogs.
EXO 23:1 Thou shalt not countenance an idle report, nor conspire with the unrighteous to be a false witness.
EXO 23:2 Thou shalt not be with the majority in wickedness, nor join with the multitude to shut out justice.
EXO 23:3 In passing judgment thou shalt not be influenced by compassion for the needy.
EXO 23:4 If thou meet the ox of thy enemy or his ass going astray thou shalt turn it back and restore it to him.
EXO 23:5 And if thou seest thine enemy's ass fallen under his burden thou shalt not pass it by, but shalt raise it up with its load.
EXO 23:6 Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of a poor man in the trial of his cause.
EXO 23:7 Thou shalt keep aloof from every thing unjust. An innocent and a righteous man thou shalt not slay; nor shalt thou justify a wicked man for the sake of bribes.
EXO 23:8 Bribes thou shalt not receive, for they blind the eyes of them who see, and pervert judgment.
EXO 23:9 You shall not afflict a stranger, for you know the heart of a stranger; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
EXO 23:10 Six years thou shalt sow thy ground and gather in the products thereof;
EXO 23:11 but on the seventh thou shalt give it rest and let it lie fallow, that the poor of thy people may eat, and what they leave, let the wild beasts of the field eat. The same thou shalt do with thy vineyards and thy olives.
EXO 23:12 Six days thou shalt do thy work; but on the seventh there shall be a rest; that thy ox and thy ass may rest: and that the son of thy handmaid and the stranger may repose.
EXO 23:13 You shall keep all that I have said to you; and make no mention of the name of strange gods, nor let it be heard out of your mouth.
EXO 23:14 Three times a year you shall keep a festival to me;
EXO 23:15 the festival of unleavened bread you shall carefully observe. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I have commanded you, at the time fixed in the month of new things. For in that month thou didst come out of Egypt. Thou shalt not appear before me empty.
EXO 23:16 Thou shalt also keep the festival of the ingathering of the first fruits of thy labours employed in sowing thy field; and the festival of completion at the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours from the field.
EXO 23:17 Three times a year all thy males must appear before the Lord thy God;
EXO 23:18 for when I have driven out the nations from before thee I will enlarge thy borders. Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; nor shall the fat of my festival remain till the morning.
EXO 23:19 The dedications of the first products of thy land thou shalt bring to the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in the milk of its dam.
EXO 23:20 Now behold I send my angel before thy face, that he may guard thee in the way, and bring thee to the land, which I have prepared for thee.
EXO 23:21 Take heed to thyself and hearken to him and disobey him not; for he should not withdraw from you; for my name is upon him.
EXO 23:22 If you will hearken diligently to this voice of mine, and do whatever I command thee, and keep my covenant, you shall be to me a peculiar people above all the nations; for the whole earth is mine, but you shall be to me a royal priesthood and a holy nation. These words you shall deliver to the children of Israel; If you will hearken diligently to my voice, and do all that I command thee, I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and an adversary to thy adversaries;
EXO 23:23 For my angel shall go before thee as thy leader, and conduct thee to the Amorite and the Chettite and the Pherezite and the Chananite and the Gergasite and the Evite and the Jebusite, and I will exterminate them.
EXO 23:24 Thou shalt not worship their gods nor serve them. Thou shalt not do according to their works; but destroy utterly and break in pieces their pillars
EXO 23:25 and worship the Lord thy God. And I will bless thy bread and thy wine and thy water, and turn away sickness from you.
EXO 23:26 There shall not be a man childless, nor a woman barren in thy land. The number of your days I will completely fulfil.
EXO 23:27 And I will send terror before thee and confound all the nations to which thou shalt go; and cause all thy adversaries to flee before thee.
EXO 23:28 And I will send hornets before thee, and thou shalt drive out the Amorites and the Evites and the Chananites and the Chettites from before thee.
EXO 23:29 I will not drive them out in one year, lest the land become a waste and the wild beasts of the earth multiply against thee.
EXO 23:30 By little and little I will drive them away from thee until thou art increased and canst possess the land.
EXO 23:31 And I will establish thy boundaries from the Red sea to the sea of Philisteim, and from the wilderness to the great river Euphrates, and deliver into your hands those who are settled in the land, or drive them out from before thee.
EXO 23:32 Thou shalt not make a treaty with them and their gods,
EXO 23:33 nor shall they dwell in thy land, lest they cause thee to sin against me. For if thou serve their gods, they will be to thee a stumbling block.
EXO 24:1 Then the Lord said to Moses, Come up to the Lord, thou and Aaron and Nadab and Abiud and seventy of the elders of Israel; and let them at a distance worship the Lord;
EXO 24:2 and let Moses alone approach near to God. As for them they shall not approach near; nor shall the people come up with them.
EXO 24:3 So Moses came and told the people all the words of God and the rules of rectitude, and all the people with one voice answered and said, All the words which the Lord hath spoken we will perform and we will be obedient.
EXO 24:4 Then Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord. And rising early next morning Moses built an altar at the foot of the mount with twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel;
EXO 24:5 and he sent out the young men of the children of Israel and they brought up whole burnt offerings and slew young bulls for a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord.
EXO 24:6 And Moses took half of the blood and poured it into bowls, and the other half of the blood he poured out against the altar.
EXO 24:7 Then he took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, All that the Lord hath spoken we will do and we will be obedient.
EXO 24:8 Thereupon Moses took the blood and scattered it towards the people and said, Behold the blood of the covenant which the Lord hath made with you touching all these words.
EXO 24:9 Then Moses and Aaron and Nadab and Abiud and seventy of the senate of Israel went up;
EXO 24:10 and they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and what was under his feet was like a pavement of Sapphire, and in clearness like the appearance of the firmament of heaven.
EXO 24:11 And of these chosen men of Israel not one uttered a dissenting voice. Now when they had appeared in the presence of God and had eaten and drunk
EXO 24:12 the Lord said to Moses, Come up to me on the mount and stay there and I will give thee the tables of stone, the law and the commandments which I have written to be promulgated to them.
EXO 24:13 Thereupon Moses arose with Joshua his attendant and they went up to the mount of God;
EXO 24:14 Having said to the elders, Remain quiet here till we return to you, and behold Aaron and Hur are with you, if any one hath a controversy with another let them go to them.
EXO 24:15 Moses then went up with Joshua to the mount and the cloud covered the mount.
EXO 24:16 And the glory of God descended on mount Sina and the cloud covered it six days; and on the seventh day the Lord called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
EXO 24:17 Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like fire blazing on the top of the mount in the view of the Israelites;
EXO 24:18 and Moses went into the midst of the cloud and ascended the mount and remained there forty days and forty nights.
EXO 25:1 And the Lord spake to Moses saying,
EXO 25:2 Say to the children of Israel, Take offerings from all who may be willing. And these you shall take as dedications to me.
EXO 25:3 And this is the offering which you shall receive from them; gold and silver and brass,
EXO 25:4 and blue and purple and scarlet yarn, and cotton thread, and goats' hair,
EXO 25:5 and rams' skins dyed red, and skins of a violet colour, and incorruptible wood,
EXO 25:6 and oil for giving light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the compound incense,
EXO 25:7 and sardine stones, and stones to be engraved for the ephod and the robe which cometh down to the feet.
EXO 25:8 And thou shalt make a sanctuary for me and I will appear among you.
EXO 25:9 And thou shalt make every thing for me according to what I show thee on this mount; according to the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its utensils, so shalt thou make them.
EXO 25:10 Thou shalt make the Ark of the testimony of incorruptible wood; two cubits and a half, the length, and a cubit and a half, the breadth, and a cubit and a half, the height.
EXO 25:11 And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold. Within and without thou shalt overlay it. And thou shalt make for it a rim of gold welked and waved around.
EXO 25:12 And thou shalt beat out for it four rings of gold and fasten them to the four corners, two rings on one side and two rings on the other side.
EXO 25:13 And thou shalt make staves of incorruptible wood and overlay them with gold.
EXO 25:14 And thou shalt put the staves in the rings on the sides of the ark, that with them the ark may be carried.
EXO 25:15 The staves shall remain immoveably in the rings of the ark.
EXO 25:16 And thou shalt deposit in the ark the testimonies which I give thee.
EXO 25:17 And thou shalt make a propitiatory; a lid of pure gold, two cubits and a half, the length; and a cubit and a half, the breadth.
EXO 25:18 And thou shalt make two cherubs of turned gold, and place them at the two sides of the propitiatory.
EXO 25:19 They shall be made, one cherub at one side, and the other cherub at the other side of the propitiatory. Thou shalt make the two cherubs at the two sides;
EXO 25:20 and the cherubs shall have their wings stretched forth above and shall overshadow the propitiatory with their wings; and their faces shall be towards each other. The faces of the cherubs shall be towards the propitiatory.
EXO 25:21 And thou shalt put the propitiatory upon the ark; and into the ark thou shalt put the testimonies which I give thee.
EXO 25:22 And there I will make myself known to thee and speak to thee from above the propitiatory, from between the two cherubs which are on the ark of the testimony, touching all that I give thee in charge to the children of Israel.
EXO 25:23 Thou shalt also make a golden table of pure gold; two cubits long; and one cubit broad; and a cubit and a half high:
EXO 25:24 And thou shalt make for it a rim of gold, welked and waved around:
EXO 25:25 And thou shalt make for it a border of a hand breadth all around, and to the border thou shalt make a welked wave all around:
EXO 25:26 And thou shalt make four rings of gold and fasten the four rings to the four sides of its feet under the border.
EXO 25:27 And the rings shall be for places to hold the staves so that with them they may carry the table.
EXO 25:28 And thou shalt make the staves of incorruptible wood and overlay them with pure gold, and with them the table shall be carried.
EXO 25:29 And thou shalt make its plates and its incense vessels and its libation vessels and the cups with which thou shalt pour out libations, all of pure gold.
EXO 25:30 And on this table thou shalt lay the loaves which are to be in my presence before me continually.
EXO 25:31 Thou shalt make also a candlestick of pure gold. Thou shalt make it a turned work. Its shaft and its branches and the cups and the knobs and the lilly ornaments shall be of one piece.
EXO 25:32 And from its sides there shall issue six branches; three branches of the candlestick from one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick from the other side,
EXO 25:33 with three cups beaten out in form of almonds, and a knob and an ornament like a lilly on each branch; and so on the six branches issuing from the candlestick:
EXO 25:34 and on the shaft there shall be four cups beaten out in form of almonds, and for each branch, knobs and ornaments like lillies, of the same piece;
EXO 25:35 the knob under the first pair of branches issuing from it; and a knob under the second pair of branches issuing from it, and so under the third pair of branches issuing from the shaft; and on the shaft four cups beaten out in form of almonds.
EXO 25:36 Let the knobs and the branches be of one piece. The whole must be turned out of one piece of pure gold.
EXO 25:37 And thou shalt make the seven lamps for it, and place the lamps so that they may give light in one row.
EXO 25:38 And its snuffers and its snuff dishes thou shalt make of pure gold.
EXO 25:39 All these utensils shall be a talent of pure gold.
EXO 25:40 See that thou make them according to the pattern shewn thee on this mount.
EXO 26:1 Thou shalt make also the tabernacle with ten curtains made of cotton thread and blue and purple and scarlet yarn with cherubs. With the workmanship of a tapestry weaver thou shalt make them.
EXO 26:2 The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits and its breadth four cubits. All the curtains shall be of the same measure.
EXO 26:3 And five curtains shall be joined together one to another and the other five curtains shall be joined together one to another.
EXO 26:4 And thou shalt make for them loops of blue yarn on the border of the outer curtain on one side for the coupling; and the same thou shalt do on the selvage of the outermost curtain of the other sheet for the second coupling.
EXO 26:5 Fifty loops thou shalt make for the one curtain, and fifty loops thou shalt make on the selvage of the other curtain for joining them together. Being directly opposite one to another they will meet each other at each joining place.
EXO 26:6 And thou shalt make fifty links of gold and fasten the curtains one to another with these links; and it shall be one tabernacle.
EXO 26:7 And thou shalt make a covering for the tabernacle of hair cloth. Thou shalt make eleven hair cloth curtains.
EXO 26:8 The length of the first curtain shall be thirty cubits and the breadth four cubits. The eleven hair cloth curtains shall be of the same measure.
EXO 26:9 And thou shalt fasten five hair curtains together, and six hair curtains together. And thou shalt lap the sixth curtain over directly in front of the tabernacle.
EXO 26:10 And thou shalt make fifty loops on the border of the first hair curtain which is in the middle over the junction; and thou shalt make fifty loops on the border of the other hair curtain which is to be joined with it,
EXO 26:11 and thou shalt make fifty links of brass, and fasten the links together by the loops and so couple the hair curtains that they may be one.
EXO 26:12 And thou shalt put the overplus of the hair curtains of the tabernacle underneath; the half of the hair curtain which remaineth, thou shalt fold in underneath that being the surplusage of the hair curtains of the tabernacle. So thou shalt fold back, underneath the tabernacle,
EXO 26:13 a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other from the length of the hair curtain more than that of the tabernacle. It shall compleatly infold both the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.
EXO 26:14 And thou shalt make a counter covering for the tabernacle of rams' skins dyed red and an upper covering of skins dyed blue.
EXO 26:15 Thou shalt also make pilasters for the tabernacle of incorruptible wood.
EXO 26:16 Thou shalt make each pilaster ten cubits long and a cubit and a half broad
EXO 26:17 with two rabbets to each pilaster to fit the pilasters one to another. In this manner thou shalt make all the pilasters of the tabernacle.
EXO 26:18 And thou shalt make the pilasters for the tabernacle twenty pilasters for the north side;
EXO 26:19 and for these twenty pilasters thou shalt make forty bases of silver, two for each pilaster, for both the ends thereof:
EXO 26:20 And for the other side towards the south, twenty pilasters
EXO 26:21 with their forty bases of silver, two for each pilaster for both the ends thereof:
EXO 26:22 and for the end of the tabernacle which is towards the west thou shalt make six pilasters;
EXO 26:23 and at the corners of the tabernacle out of the hinder ends thou shalt make two pilasters and the side on the end shall be of the same piece and as wide as the other side;
EXO 26:24 both sides shall be equal from the corner to the first joint. That thou mayst do this at both corners the corner pilasters must have equal sides.
EXO 26:25 So there will be eight pilasters and their bases of silver sixteen, two for each pilaster for the two ends thereof.
EXO 26:26 And thou shalt make bars of incorruptible wood; five for one range of pilasters on one side of the tabernacle,
EXO 26:27 and five bars for the other range of pilasters on the other side of the tabernacle; and five for the end of the tabernacle facing the west.
EXO 26:28 And let the bar which is along the middle of the ranges of pilasters reach from one corner to the other.
EXO 26:29 And thou shalt overlay the pilasters with gold. And thou shalt make rings of gold into which thou shalt put the bars; and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
EXO 26:30 And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the pattern shewn thee on this mount.
EXO 26:31 Thou shalt also make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread.
EXO 26:32 This thou shalt make a work inwoven with cherubs: and thou shalt hang it on four pillars of incorruptible wood overlaid with gold, the capitals of which are to be of gold and their four bases of silver.
EXO 26:33 And having hung up the veil upon the pillars, thou shalt bring in there within the veil the ark of the testimony. And the veil shall make a division for you, between the Holy and the Holy of Holies.
EXO 26:34 And with the veil thou shalt cover from view the ark of the testimony in the Holy of Holies.
EXO 26:35 And thou shalt place the table without the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the south side of the tabernacle, and the table thou shalt place on the north side of the tabernacle.
EXO 26:36 And thou shalt make a draw curtain for the door of the tabernacle, of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread, the work of an embroiderer;
EXO 26:37 And for this veil thou shalt make five pillars and overlay them with gold and their capitals shall be of gold but thou shalt cast for them five bases of brass.

EXO 27:2 And thou shalt make the horns at the four corners. The horns shall be a component part of it and thou shalt overlay them with brass.
EXO 27:3 And thou shalt make a border for the Altar. And its cover and its pans and its flesh hooks and its fire hearth and all its utensils thou shalt make of brass.
EXO 27:4 And thou shalt make for it a brass grate of net-work; and for the grate thou shalt make four rings of brass under the four sides;
EXO 27:5 and thou shalt put them under the grate of the altar below [now the grate must be half way up the height of the altar.]
EXO 27:6 And thou shalt make for the altar poles of incorruptible wood and overlay them with brass,
EXO 27:7 and thou shalt put the poles into the rings; and let the poles be along the sides of the altar in carrying it.
EXO 27:8 Hollow, and of boards thou shalt make it. According to what is shewn thee on this mount so shalt thou make it.

EXO 27:10 and their pillars twenty. And the twenty bases of these pillars shall be of brass and their links and their fillets of silver.
EXO 27:11 So for the north side there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long with their twenty pillars; and the twenty bases of them shall be of brass, and the links and the fillets of these pillars and their bases shall be overlaid with silver.
EXO 27:12 And for the breadth of the court westward there shall be hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their bases ten.
EXO 27:13 And for the breadth of the court eastward there shall be hangings of fifty cubits,

EXO 27:15 and for the other side of the gateway, the length of the hangings shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three and their bases three:
