EXO 27:21 in the tabernacle of the testimony. On the outside of the veil which is before the covenant Aaron and his sons shall keep it burning from evening till morning before the Lord. This shall be an everlasting ordinance for your generations among the children of Israel.
EXO 28:1 Therefore associate thou with thyself thy brother Aaron and his sons, that from among the children of Israel, Aaron and Nadab and Abiud and Eleazar and Ithamar the sons of Aaron may minister to me in the priest's office.
EXO 28:2 And thou shalt make for thy brother Aaron holy raiment for dignity and glory.
EXO 28:3 For this purpose speak to all those who are wise in heart, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom and understanding and let them make the holy raiment of Aaron for the sanctuary, in which he shall minister to me.
EXO 28:4 Now these are the robes which they shall make, The breast plate, and the ephod, and a long robe reaching down to the feet, and a broidered vesture, and a mitre, and a girdle. And that they may make holy robes for Aaron and his sons to minister to me,
EXO 28:5 they shall take the gold and the blue and the purple and the scarlet yarn and the cotton thread,
EXO 28:6 and they shall make the ephod of cotton thread, a woven work of an embroiderer.
EXO 28:7 It shall have two shoulder pieces connected with it and to one another, being joined at the two sides.
EXO 28:8 And the texture of the two shoulder pieces which are over it shall be of the same fabrick and materials as it is; of pure gold and of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread.
EXO 28:9 And thou shalt take the two stones, smaragdine stones, and engrave upon them the names of the sons of Israel,
EXO 28:10 six names on one stone and the other six names on the other stone; according to their births.
EXO 28:11 With the workmanship of a skilful engraver, like the engraving of a seal, thou shalt engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel.
EXO 28:12 And thou shalt fix these two stones on the shoulders of the ephod. They are stones of remembrance for the children of Israel. And Aaron shall carry the names of the children of Israel before the Lord on his two shoulders as a memorial concerning them.
EXO 28:13 Thou shalt also make little shields of pure gold;
EXO 28:14 and thou shalt make two pieces of net work of pure gold intermixed with flowers, the work of a curious plaiter, and thou shalt put the plaited net works upon the little shields in the fore front of the shoulder pieces.
EXO 28:15 And thou shalt make the oracle of judgment, a work of an embroiderer" thou shalt make it, conformable to the ephod, of gold and blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread;
EXO 28:16 thou shalt make it four square. It shall be double. The length of it a span and the breadth a span.
EXO 28:17 And thou shalt inweave in it a texture to contain stones in four rows. One row of stones shall be a sardius, a topaz and a smaragdus; this shall be the first row.
EXO 28:18 And the second row, an anthrax, and a sapphire and a jaspis;
EXO 28:19 and the third row, a ligure, an agate and an amethyst;
EXO 28:20 and the fourth row, a chrysolite and a beryl and an onyx. They must be cased in gold, and bound together with gold according to their rows.
EXO 28:21 And the stones from the names of the sons of Israel must be twelve according to their names. They must be engraved like seals every one with its name for the twelve tribes.
EXO 28:22 And thou shalt make upon the oracle net works inwoven with it, a chain work of pure gold;
EXO 28:23 and thou shalt make for the oracle two rings of gold and thou shalt put the two rings of gold on the two upper ends of the oracle.
EXO 28:24 And thou shalt put the nettings and chain works of gold on the two rings on the two upper ends of the oracle;
EXO 28:25 and the other two ends of the two pieces of net work thou shalt put on the two pieces of plaiters work, so as to put them upon the shoulders of the ephod over against each other in the fore front.
EXO 28:26 And thou shalt make two rings of gold and put them on the two wings of the oracle on the very tip next to the lowest hinder tip of the ephod:
EXO 28:27 And thou shalt make two rings of gold and put them below on both the shoulder pieces of the ephod, over against the upper juncture of the contexture of the ephod;
EXO 28:28 And from the two rings which are on it thou shalt bind the oracle to the two rings of the ephod, which are fastened with blue yarn and plaited into the texture of the ephod, that the oracle may not be loosed from the ephod.
EXO 28:29 And Aaron shall carry on his breast the names of the children of Israel on the oracle of judgment, when he goeth into the sanctuary, as a memorial before God.
EXO 28:30 And upon the oracle of judgment thou shalt put the Manifestation and the Truth. And it shall be on the breast of Aaron, when he goeth into the sanctuary, before the Lord. And Aaron shall carry the judgments of the Israelites upon his breast before the Lord continually.
EXO 28:31 And thou shalt make a robe to be worn under this, which shall reach down to the feet, entirely of blue yarn:
EXO 28:32 And the opening of it at the neck shall be in the middle, having a hem round the opening, a woven work, the binding being interwoven with it, that it may not be rent.
EXO 28:33 And underneath the lower border of this robe thou shalt make clusters as of a blooming pomegranate of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread. Under the border of this robe round about thou shalt make clusters all of the same appearance and golden bells between them round about:
EXO 28:34 by a cluster a golden bell with a running branch on the border of the robe round about;
EXO 28:35 so that when Aaron officiateth the sound of him may be heard as he goeth into the sanctuary before the Lord, or cometh out; that he may not die.
EXO 28:36 And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it with the engraving of a seal, Holiness to the Lord,
EXO 28:37 and thou shalt fix it on a blue lace; and it shall be upon the mitre.
EXO 28:38 It shall be upon the front of the mitre and upon Aaron's forehead; and Aaron shall bear away the sins of the holy things which the children of Israel may dedicate; of every gift of their holy things. And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead continually to make them acceptable before the Lord.
EXO 28:39 Now the embroideries of the vestures shall be of cotton and thou shalt make a tiara of cotton, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of an embroiderer.
EXO 28:40 And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make vestures and girdles. Thou shalt also make tiaras for them for dignity and glory.
EXO 28:41 And with these thou shalt clothe Aaron thy brother and his sons with him. And thou shalt anoint them and fill their bands and consecrate them that they may minister to me in the priest's office.
EXO 28:42 Moreover thou shalt make for them linen drawers to cover their nakedness. These shall reach from the loins to the thighs,
EXO 28:43 and Aaron and his sons shall wear them when they come into the tabernacle of the testimony or when they come near to minister at the altar of the sanctuary, that they may not bring sin upon themselves and die. This shall be a perpetual statute for him and his seed after him.
EXO 29:1 Now these are the things which thou shalt do for them. Thou shalt consecrate them that they may minister to me in the priest's office. For this purpose thou shalt take one young bull of the herd and two rams without blemish
EXO 29:2 and unleavened bread tempered with oil and unleavened cakes anointed with oil. These thou shalt make of fine flour
EXO 29:3 and put them in one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the young bull and the two rams.
EXO 29:4 Then thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony and wash them with water.
EXO 29:5 Then taking the robes thou shalt put on Aaron thy brother the robe reaching down to the feet, and the ephod, and the oracle; and thou shalt fasten for him the oracle to the ephod.
EXO 29:6 Then thou shalt put the mitre on his head and fasten the plate Holiness to the mitre.
EXO 29:7 And thou shalt take some of the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him.
EXO 29:8 Then thou shalt bring his sons near, and clothe them with vestures
EXO 29:9 and gird them with girdles and put the tiaras on them. And the office of serving me as priests shall be theirs for ever. Then thou shalt consecrate the bands of Aaron, and the bands of his sons;
EXO 29:10 for this purpose thou shalt bring the young bull to the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony and Aaron and his sons shall lay their bands on the head of the young bull before the Lord at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony.
EXO 29:11 Then thou shalt slay the bull before the Lord at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony,
EXO 29:12 and thou shalt take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with thy finger; and all the rest of the blood thou shalt pour out at the base of the altar.
EXO 29:13 And thou shalt take the whole caul which covereth the belly and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with the suet on them; and lay them on the altar:
EXO 29:14 but the flesh of the bull and the hide and the excrements thou shalt burn with fire without the camp: for it is a sin offering.
EXO 29:15 Then thou shalt take one ram and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram;
EXO 29:16 and thou shalt slay it; and taking the blood thou shalt pour it around the altar.
EXO 29:17 Then thou shalt cut the ram in pieces according to its members and thou shalt wash the entrails and the feet with water and lay them on the pieces with the head,
EXO 29:18 and thou shalt carry up this whole ram on the altar for a whole burnt offering to the Lord, for a sweet savour. It is a burnt offering to the Lord.
EXO 29:19 Then thou shalt take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of this ram;
EXO 29:20 and thou shalt kill it; and thou shalt take some of its blood and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot; and on the tip of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the great toes of their right feet:
EXO 29:21 and thou shalt take some of the blood from the altar, and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it upon Aaron and his raiment, and upon his sons and their raiment. So shall he and his raiment be hallowed; and his sons and their raiment with him. But the blood of this ram thou shalt pour against the altar round about.
EXO 29:22 And thou shalt take from this ram the fat tail, and the caul which covereth the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys with the suet on them, and the right shoulder [for this is a consecration offering]
EXO 29:23 and one loaf of oil bread, and one cake out of the basket of unleavened cakes which were laid before the Lord;
EXO 29:24 and thou shalt lay all these upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons, and set them apart as a dedication before the Lord.
EXO 29:25 Then thou shalt take them out of their hands and carry them up, upon the altar of burnt offerings for a smell of fragrance before the Lord. It is an homage offering to the Lord.
EXO 29:26 And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration and set it apart as a dedication before the Lord, and thou shalt have it for a portion.
EXO 29:27 And thou shalt hallow this breast dedication and the shoulder dedication which was set apart and taken from the ram of consecration on account of Aaron and his sons;
EXO 29:28 and they shall belong to Aaron and his sons by an everlasting statute from the Israelites. For this is a dedication and it shall be a portion taken from the Israelites, from the burnt offerings of thanksgiving of the children of Israel; a portion set apart for the Lord.
EXO 29:29 Now the sanctuary robes which are appropriate to Aaron shall be for his sons after him to be anointed in them and to consecrate their hands.
EXO 29:30 The priest; that one of his sons who is to succeed him and come into the tabernacle of the testimony to minister in the Holies shall put them on seven days.
EXO 29:31 And thou shalt take the flesh of the ram of consecration and boil this flesh in a holy place;
EXO 29:32 and Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of this ram and the bread which is in the basket. At the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony
EXO 29:33 they shall eat those meats, with which they were hallowed to consecrate their hands with them, to hallow themselves. None of another family shall eat of them, for they are holy.
EXO 29:34 And if any of the flesh of the consecration sacrifice or of the bread be left till the morning, thou shalt burn what remaineth with fire. It shall not be eaten; for it is a dedication.
EXO 29:35 Having done thus for Aaron and his sons according to all that I have commanded thee, and consecrated their hands seven days,
EXO 29:36 thou shalt offer on the day of the purification a young bull for a sin offering, and thou shalt purify the altar, when thou consecratest upon it, and anoint it so as to hallow it.
EXO 29:37 Seven days thou shalt purify the altar and hallow it, so shall the altar be most holy. Whoever toucheth it shall be hallowed.
EXO 29:38 Now these are what thou shalt offer on the altar; two yearling lambs without blemish every day on the altar continually,
EXO 29:39 an offering of homage without intermission;
EXO 29:40 the one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning with a tenth of fine flour tempered with a quarter of a hin of expressed oil; and for a libation a quarter of a hin of wine for the first lamb:
EXO 29:41 and the other lamb thou shalt offer in the evening with the same cake offering and the same libation as in the morning. For a smell of fragrance; as an offering of homage to the Lord
EXO 29:42 thou shalt offer this continual sacrifice throughout your generations, at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord in the places where I shall make myself known to thee so as to speak to thee.
EXO 29:43 And there I will issue orders to the children of Israel and be hallowed by my glory.
EXO 29:44 And I will hallow the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar; and I will hallow Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest's office;
EXO 29:45 and I will be invoked by the children of Israel and will be their God.
EXO 29:46 And they shall know that I am the Lord their God who brought them out of Egypt to be invoked by them and to be their God.
EXO 30:1 Thou shalt also make an Altar to burn incense thereon. Of incorruptible wood thou shalt make it
EXO 30:2 a cubit long and a cubit broad. It shall be square and the height shall be two cubits. The horns shall be a component part of it.
EXO 30:3 And thou shalt overlay with pure gold its grate and its sides round about and the horns thereof. And thou shall make for it a wreathed border of gold round about.
EXO 30:4 And thou shalt make two rings of pure gold under its wreathed border for the two corners. Thou shalt make them on the two sides and there shall be clasps for the staves with which it is to be carried.
EXO 30:5 And thou shalt make staves of incorruptible wood and overlay them with gold.
EXO 30:6 And thou shalt place this before the veil, which is over the ark of the testimonies, from which I will make myself known to thee.
EXO 30:7 And Aaron shall burn thereon every morning compound incense beaten fine. When he replenisheth the lamps he shall burn incense thereon.
EXO 30:8 And when Aaron lighteth the lamps in the evening he shall burn incense thereon every day continually before the Lord throughout their generations.
EXO 30:9 And upon it thou shalt not offer any other incense offering, homage offering, nor cake offering; nor shalt thou pour a libation thereon.
EXO 30:10 But Aaron shall make an atonement on it; on the horns thereof, once a year. With the blood of the purifying sacrifice he shall purify it throughout their generations. It is a Holy of Holies to the Lord.
EXO 30:11 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 30:12 When thou takest an account of the children of Israel, on being reviewed they shall give every man a ransom for his life to the Lord, so there shall be no destruction among them by the review made of them.
EXO 30:13 And this is what every one who passeth review shall give, the half of a didrachm, which is according to the holy didrachm, twenty oboli making a didrachm. And this half of a didrachm shall be an offering to the Lord.
EXO 30:14 Every one who passeth the review from twenty years old and upwards shall give this offering to the Lord.
EXO 30:15 He who is rich shall add nothing to it, and he who is poor shall deduct nothing from the half of a didrachm when you give this offering to the Lord to make atonement for your lives.
EXO 30:16 And thou shalt take the money of this offering from the children of Israel and apply it to the service of the tabernacle of the testimony. And it shall be a memorial before the Lord to make atonement for your lives.
EXO 30:17 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 30:18 Make a laver of brass with its base of brass for the purpose of washing. And thou shalt place it between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar, and thou shalt pour water into it.
EXO 30:19 And out of it Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet with water.
EXO 30:20 When they go into the tabernacle of the testimony, they shall wash with water. That they may escape death, when they go to the altar to minister as priests and to carry up the whole burnt offerings to the Lord
EXO 30:21 they shall wash their hands and their feet with water; and when they go into the tabernacle of the testimony they shall wash with water that they may not die: and this shall be to them a perpetual ordinance; to him and his posterity after him.
EXO 30:22 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 30:23 Thou thyself shalt take spices; the flower of choice myrrh five hundred shekels: and sweet scented cinnamon half as much; two hundred and fifty shekels; and sweet scented calamus two hundred and fifty shekels;
EXO 30:24 and of iris five hundred shekels, sanctuary weight; and olive oil a hin;
EXO 30:25 and of these thou shalt make an holy ointment, an odoriferous perfume, compounded by the art of an apothecary.
EXO 30:26 It shall be a holy anointing oil and with it thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the testimony and the ark of the tabernacle of the testimony
EXO 30:27 and all the utensils thereof, and the candlestick and all the utensils belonging to it;
EXO 30:28 and the altar of incense; and the altar of whole burnt offerings and all its utensils; and the table and all its utensils and the laver.
EXO 30:29 And thou shalt hallow them, and they shall be holy of holies. Every one who toucheth them shall be hallowed.
EXO 30:30 And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons and hallow them to minister to me as priests.
EXO 30:31 And thon shalt speak to the children of Israel and say, This shall be to you a holy anointing oil throughout your generations.
EXO 30:32 Upon the flesh of man it must not be poured; nor shall you make any for your selves according to this composition. It shall be holy, and held in veneration by you.
EXO 30:33 Whoever shall make any like it or give any of it to a stranger, shall be rooted out from among his people.
EXO 30:34 Moreover the Lord said to Moses, Take thee spices; stacte, onycha and sweet scented chalbanum and pellucid frankincense, of each an equal quantity.
EXO 30:35 And of these they shall make compound incense mixed up by the art of an apothecary, a pure holy composition.
EXO 30:36 And thou shalt beat some of it fine, and lay it over against the testimonies in the tabernacle of the testimony, where I shall make myself known to thee. It shall be to you a most holy incense.
EXO 30:37 According to the composition thereof you shall not make any for yourselves. You shall consider it as a holy thing appropriate to the Lord.
EXO 30:38 Whoever shall make any like it to yield a fragrance for himself shall be rooted out from among his people.

EXO 31:12 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
EXO 31:13 Charge the children of Israel saying, See that you keep my sabbaths. It is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifieth you;
EXO 31:14 therefore you shall keep the sabbath, because it is holy to the Lord for you. He who profaneth it shall surely be put to death. Whoever shall do any work on it, that person shall be rooted out from among his people.
EXO 31:15 Six days thou shalt perform works, but on the seventh day are the sabbaths, a rest holy to the Lord. Whoever shall do any work on the seventh day shall be put to death.
EXO 31:16 Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbaths and cause them to be kept throughout their generations. It is an everlasting covenant between me and the children of Israel.
EXO 31:17 It is for me a perpetual sign that in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth and rested on the seventh.
EXO 31:18 Here he paused, and gave Moses, when he had ceased speaking to him on mount Sina, two tables of the testimony; tables of stone written with the finger of God.

EXO 32:17 And Joshua hearing the sound of the people shouting said to Moses, There is a sound of war in the camp.

EXO 32:24 Whereupon I said to them, If any one hath golden ornaments take them off. So they gave me and I cast into the fire, and out came that bull.

EXO 34:2 and be ready against the morning and thou shalt come up to mount Sina, and wait for me there on the top of the mount,
EXO 34:3 but let none come up with thee nor be seen in all the mountain; and let neither flocks nor herds pasture near the mount.
EXO 34:4 So when Moses had hewn two tables of stone such as the first he arose early in the morning and went up mount Sina, as the Lord had commanded him. And Moses took the two tables of stone
EXO 34:5 and the Lord descended in a cloud and stood by him there and called in the name of the Lord.
EXO 34:6 And the Lord passed by before him and proclaimed, The Lord, the God compassionate and merciful, long suffering and abundant in goodness and truth,
EXO 34:7 keeping kindness and mercy for thousands, taking away transgressions, iniquities and sins, will by no means clear the guilty, when he bringeth the transgressions of fathers on children and children s children to the third and fourth generation.
EXO 34:8 Upon which Moses made haste and having bowed down on the ground he worshipped

EXO 34:11 Attend thou to all that I command thee. Behold I drive out before you the Amorite and the Chananite and the Pherezite and the Chettite and the Evite and the Gergasite and the Jebusite:
EXO 34:12 Take thou heed to thyself that thou make not a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which thou art going, lest it become a stumbling block to you.
EXO 34:13 Their altars you shall demolish: their pillars you shall break to pieces; and their groves you shall cut down; and the graven images of their gods you shall burn with fire.
EXO 34:14 For you must not worship other gods; for the Lord God, a zealous name, is a zealous God.
EXO 34:15 Peradventure, shouldst thou make a covenant with those settled in that land, when they go a whoring after their gods and sacrifice to their gods and invite thee thou mayst eat with them;
EXO 34:16 and shouldst thou take their daughters for thy sons and give some of thy daughters to their sons, thy daughters may go a whoring after their gods and thy sons may go a whoring after their gods.
EXO 34:17 Thou shalt not make for thyself molten gods.
EXO 34:18 The festival of unleavened bread thou shalt keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread as I commanded thee at the set time in the month of new things; for in the month of new things thou didst come out of Egypt.
EXO 34:19 With regard to every firstling, the males are mine; every firstling of kine and sheep;
EXO 34:20 but the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a sheep; and if thou wilt not redeem it with that thou shalt pay the worth of it. Every first born of thy sons thou shalt redeem. Thou shalt not appear before me empty.
EXO 34:21 Six days perform works, but on the seventh thou shalt rest. In seeding time and harvest it shall be a rest.
EXO 34:22 The festival of weeks thou shalt celebrate for me at the beginning of the reaping of wheat; and the festival of the ingathering in the middle of the year.
EXO 34:23 Three times a year all thy males shall appear before the Lord the God of Israel.
EXO 34:24 For when I shall have driven out the nations from before thee and enlarged thy borders, none shall covet thy land, when thou comest up to appear before the Lord thy God three times a year.
EXO 34:25 Thou shalt not offer the blood of my burnt offerings with leaven, nor shall the victims of the passover festival remain till the morning.
EXO 34:26 The first fruits of thy land thou shalt lay by for the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boil a lamb in the milk of its dam.
EXO 34:27 Then the Lord said to Moses, Write for thyself these words; for on these terms I have made a covenant with thee and Israel.
EXO 34:28 And Moses was there before the Lord forty days and forty nights. He did not eat bread nor drink water. And he wrote on the tables the words of the covenant; the ten commandments.
EXO 34:29 And when Moses came down from the mount with the two tables in his hands, he did not know, while he was coming down from the mount, that the skin of his face had been irradiated with glory by his talking with him;
EXO 34:30 but when Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and that the skin of his face was irradiated with glory, they were afraid to approach him.
EXO 34:31 Whereupon Moses called them; and Aaron and all the chiefs of the congregation turned to him and Moses spoke to them.
EXO 34:32 And after that all the sons of Israel came to him; and he enjoined upon them all that the Lord had given him in charge on mount Sina.
EXO 34:33 And when he had done speaking to them he put a veil on his face.
EXO 34:34 But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak to him he took off the veil until he came out, and when he came out and rehearsed to all the children of Israel what the Lord commanded him
EXO 34:35 [as the children of Israel saw that Moses' face was irradiated with glory therefore] Moses put the veil on his face until he should go in to speak to him.
EXO 35:1 Then Moses assembled all the congregation of the Israelites and said, These are the things which the Lord said you shall do.
EXO 35:2 Six days thou shalt perform works; but on the seventh there shall be a rest, holy sabbaths, a rest to the Lord; whoever doth work on it let him be put to death.
EXO 35:3 You shall not kindle a fire in any of your habitations on the sabbath day. I am the Lord.
EXO 35:4 Again Moses spoke to all the congregation of the Israelites and said, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded saying,
EXO 35:5 Take from yourselves an offering for the Lord. Let every one whose heart is so disposed bring these offerings to the Lord, gold, silver, brass,
EXO 35:6 blue, purple and scarlet yarn doubled; and cotton thread and goats' hair
EXO 35:7 and rams' skins dyed red and skins dyed blue and incorruptible wood
EXO 35:8 and sardine stones and stones to be engraved for the ephod and the long robe;
EXO 35:9 and let every wise hearted man among you come and make all the works which the Lord hath commanded;
EXO 35:10 the tabernacle, and the coverings, and upper coverings and the hangings, and the bars and the pilasters,
EXO 35:11 and the ark of the testimony with its staves and its propitiatory,
EXO 35:12 and the veil and the hangings of the court with its pillars,
EXO 35:13 and the smaragdine stones
EXO 35:14 and the incense and the anointing oil
EXO 35:15 and the table with all its utensils,
EXO 35:16 and the candlestick for light with all its utensils,
EXO 35:17 and the altar with all its utensils,
EXO 35:18 and the holy garments of Aaron the priest,
EXO 35:19 and the robes and the sacerdotal vestures for the sons of Aaron in which they are to minister and the anointing oil and the compound incense.
EXO 35:20 Thereupon all the congregation of the children of Israel went out from Moses and all whose heart prompted them and all to whom it seemed good in their mind brought every one an offering.
EXO 35:21 And when they had brought an offering to the Lord for all the works of the tabernacle of the testimony, and for all its appurtenances, and for all the holy garments,
EXO 35:22 then the men brought from their wives; every one as it seemed good brought seals and pendants and rings and necklaces and bracelets and all sorts of jewels of gold.
EXO 35:23 And when they had all brought their offerings of gold to the Lord, then every one who had cotton or skins of blue or rams' skins dyed red brought
EXO 35:24 them; And every one who had made a dedication of silver or brass brought them as offerings to the Lord; and they who had incorruptible timber did the same.
EXO 35:25 And when they had brought materials for all the works of the service, then every woman skilled in spinning brought blue and purple and scar let and cotton thread;
EXO 35:26 and all the women who had understanding and skill spun the goats' hair.
EXO 35:27 And the chiefs brought the smaragdine stones and the stones to be set in the ephod and the oracle,
EXO 35:28 and the materials both for the anointing oil and the compound incense.
EXO 35:29 And when all the Israelites, men and women, whose understanding prompted them to promote all the works which the Lord had by Moses commanded them to make, had brought an offering to the Lord,
EXO 35:30 then Moses said to the children of Israel, Behold God hath called by name Beseleel the son of Ourius the son of Hur of the tribe of Judas
EXO 35:31 and filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and skill in all things
EXO 35:32 to execute all works of architecture and to work up gold and silver and brass
EXO 35:33 and to cut stones and to model wood and to perform every kind of curious workmanship.
EXO 35:34 He hath indeed qualified him and Eliab the son of Achisamach of the tribe of Dan
EXO 35:35 and hath filled them with wisdom, knowledge and skill to know how to make all the works of the sanctuary, and to weave the embroidery and tapestry with scarlet yarn and cotton thread; to execute every kind of work in architecture and embroidery.
EXO 36:1 Accordingly Beseleel and Eliab and every man skilled in arts, to whom had been given wisdom and understanding to know how to execute every kind of work suitable for the holy service, performed it according to all that the Lord had commanded.
EXO 36:2 When Moses called Beseleel and Eliab and all who had skill: every one in whose heart God had put knowledge and all who were freely willing to come to the work so as to finish it compleatly,
EXO 36:3 they received from Moses all the offerings which the Israelites had brought for making all the works of the sanctuary. They received also the offerings from those who still continued to bring them in, every morning.
EXO 36:4 And all the artists who did the works of the sanctuary attended diligently every one at the work in which he was engaged.
EXO 36:5 And when Moses was told that the people were bringing in more than sufficient for all the works which the Lord had ordered to be made,
EXO 36:6 Moses issued orders and caused proclamation to be made throughout the camp saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offerings of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing any more;
EXO 36:7 for the materials which they had were sufficient for all the work to be done; and there was an overplus.
EXO 36:8 Now the most skilful among the Workmen made the holy garments, which are appropriate to Aaron the priest as the Lord commanded Moses.
EXO 36:9 They made the ephod of gold and of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread,
EXO 36:10 the thin plates of gold being: cut into fine threads so as to be inwoven with the blue and purple and with the scarlet yarn and cotton thread. They made it a woven work,
EXO 36:11 the shoulder pieces having from both the sides a work woven one piece into another alternately, each convoluted through itself out of itself.
EXO 36:12 They made it according to its peculiar fabrick of gold and blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread as the Lord commanded Moses.
EXO 36:13 And they worked the two smaragdine stones fastened with it and set in gold, which were excavated and engraven, like the engraving of a seal, with the names of the sons of Israel;
EXO 36:14 and put them on the shoulders of the ephod, as stones of remembrance of the children of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.
EXO 36:15 And they made the Oracle, a work of embroidery, like the workmanship of the ephod, of gold and blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread.
EXO 36:16 The Oracle they made double, and it was square, a span, the length; and a span, the breadth on both sides.
EXO 36:17 And there was interwoven with it a texture containing stones in four rows; the first row of stones, a sardine and a topaz and a smaragdus;
EXO 36:18 and the second row, an anthrax and a sapphire and a jaspis;
EXO 36:19 and the third row, a ligure and an agate and an amethyst,
EXO 36:20 and the fourth row, a chrysolite and a beryl and an onyx, set in gold and bound in with gold.
EXO 36:21 Now these stones were twelve from the names of the sons of Israel, engraven like seals, every one with its peculiar name, for the twelve tribes.
EXO 36:22 And on the oracle they made pieces of plaited net work, the work of a plaiter, of pure gold.
EXO 36:23 They made also two little shields of gold and two rings of gold;
EXO 36:24 and they put the two rings of gold on the two upper sides of the oracle;
EXO 36:25 and they put the two pieces of plaited work of gold on the two rings on the two sides of the oracle;
EXO 36:26 and they put the two pieces of plaited work for the two junctions, on the two shields which were on the shoulders of the ephod over against each other in front;
EXO 36:27 and they made two rings of gold and put them on the two wings below the tip of the oracle and on the tip of the hinder part of the ephod on the inside;
EXO 36:28 and they made two rings of gold and put them on both the shoulder pieces of the ephod underneath, over against the upper junction of the texture of the ephod;
EXO 36:29 and they fastened the oracle by the rings on it to the rings of the ephod which were fastened to it with blue yarn, being plaited into the texture of the ephod, that the oracle might not be loosed from the ephod, as the Lord commanded Moses.
EXO 36:30 And they made the long robe under the ephod, a woven work, all of blue yarn:
EXO 36:31 and the opening of the under robe in the middle was woven with a binding of plaited work, having a hem all around the hole that it might not be rent.
EXO 36:32 And on the border of the robe below, they made clusters as of a blooming pomegranate of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and cotton thread:
EXO 36:33 And they made golden bells and put the bells on the border of the robe round about between the clusters,
EXO 36:34 a golden bell and a cluster on the border of the robe round about, to minister in as the Lord commanded Moses.
EXO 36:35 And they made cotton vestures, a woven work for Aaron and his sons
EXO 36:36 and the tiaras of cotton and the mitre of cotton and the drawers of cotton,
EXO 36:37 and the girdles of cotton thread and of blue and purple and scarlet yarn a work of embroidery as the Lord commanded Moses.
EXO 36:38 And they made the plate of gold, a dedication of the sanctuary, of pure gold, [[39 and wrote thereon in letters engraved like a seal, Holiness to the Lord, 40 and put it on a ribbon of blue that it might be hung upon the mitre above as the Lord commanded Moses.]]

LEV 1:1 Then the Lord called up Moses and spoke to him out of the tabernacle of the testimony saying,
LEV 1:2 Speak to the children of Israel and thou shalt say to them, When any man among you bringeth gifts to the Lord from your cattle, you shall bring them either from the flocks or the herds.
LEV 1:3 If his gift be a whole burnt offering from the herd, he shall bring a male without blemish to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony. He shall bring it before the Lord for acceptance;
LEV 1:4 and he shall lay his hand on the head of the homage offering to be accepted for him; to make atonement for him.
LEV 1:5 And they shall kill the young bull before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron the priests shall carry the blood and pour it out round about on the altar which is at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony;
LEV 1:6 and having flayed the whole burnt offering they shall cut it in quarters;
LEV 1:7 and the sons of Aaron the priests shall put the fire on the altar and pile wood on the fire;
LEV 1:8 and the sons of Aaron the priests shall lay the quarters with the head and the suet on the wood which is on the fire on the altar;
LEV 1:9 and they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priests shall lay them all on the altar. It is an homage gift, a sacrifice, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 1:10 And if his gift to the Lord be from the flocks, either from the lambs or the kids for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring a male without blemish
LEV 1:11 and he shall lay his hands on its head; and they shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the Lord: and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood on the altar round about;
LEV 1:12 then they shall cut it in quarters and the priests shall lay these with the head and the suet on the wood which is on the fire on the altar;
LEV 1:13 and they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water; and the priests shall carry them all up and lay them on the altar. It is an homage offering, a sacrifice, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 1:14 And if he bring an homage offering from among the fowls as his gift to the Lord; he shall bring his gift either from among the turtle doves or the pigeons;
LEV 1:15 and the priest shall carry it to the altar and wring off the head, and the priest shall lay it on the altar; then he shall squeeze out the blood against the base of the altar;
LEV 1:16 and he shall take away the craw with the feathers and throw it on the east side of the altar into the ash hole,
LEV 1:17 then he shall break it off from the wings but shall not divide it; and the priest shall lay it on the altar, on the wood which is upon the fire. It is an homage offering, a sacrifice, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 2:1 And when any person shall bring a sacrificial gift to the Lord, his gift shall be fine flour, and he shall pour oil on it and lay frankincense on it.
LEV 2:2 It is a sacrifice; and he shall carry it to the sons of Aaron, the priests; and the priest having taken out a handful of the flour with the oil, and all the frankincense thereof shall lay this memorial of it on the altar. It is a sacrifice, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 2:3 And the rest of the sacrifice shall be for Aaron and his sons, a most holy portion from the sacrifices of the Lord.
LEV 2:4 And if he bring a gift, a baked sacrifice from the oven, his gift to the Lord shall be of fine flour; he shall bring unleavened loaves tempered with oil or unleavened cakes anointed with oil.
LEV 2:5 And if thy gift be a sacrifice from the pan, it must be of fine flour tempered with oil, without leaven.
LEV 2:6 And having broken it to pieces thou shalt crumble the fragments and pour oil thereon. It is a sacrifice to the Lord.
LEV 2:7 And if thy gift be a sacrifice from the hearth, the fine flour must be made up with oil.
LEV 2:8 And he shall bring the sacrifice which he hath prepared of these materials for the Lord and carry it to the priest; and the priest shall carry it near to the altar
LEV 2:9 and shall take from the sacrifice the memorial of it and lay it on the altar. It is an homage offering, a smell of fragrance for the Lord;
LEV 2:10 and the rest of the sacrifice shall be for Aaron and his sons. These are most holy portions from the homage offerings of the Lord.
LEV 2:11 Every sacrifice which you bring to the Lord, you shall prepare without leaven; for you must not bring any kind of leaven, not even honey, as a gift to pay homage to the Lord.
LEV 2:12 You may bring them as gifts of first fruits to the Lord; but they shall not be laid on the altar for a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 2:13 Every gift of your sacrifice must be seasoned with salt. You shall not withhold the salt of the covenant of the Lord from your sacrifices. With every gift you make, you shall offer salt to the Lord your God.
LEV 2:14 And when thou bringest a sacrifice of first fruits to the Lord, it must be young parched grains broken in the mill. This sacrifice of the first fruits thou shalt offer to the Lord,
LEV 2:15 and thou shalt pour oil on it and put frankincense on it. It is a sacrifice.
LEV 2:16 And the priest shall carry up as the memorial of it some of the broken grains with all the frankincense. It is an homage offering to the Lord.
LEV 3:1 And if his gift to the Lord be a sacrifice of thanks giving, and he bring it from the herd, whether it be a male or a female, he shall bring it without blemish before the Lord
LEV 3:2 and shall lay his hands on the head of the gift and kill it before the Lord at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony. And the sons of Aaron, the priests shall pour the blood on the altar of whole burnt offerings round about:
LEV 3:3 And from the sacrifice of thanksgiving they shall offer up as an homage offering to the Lord the caul which covereth the belly and all the suet on the belly
LEV 3:4 and the two kidneys with the suet on them, and that on the flanks, and with the kidneys he shall take off the lobe of the liver.
LEV 3:5 And the sons of Aaron, the priests shall offer up these on the altar; on the whole burnt offerings which are on the wood on the fire. It is an offering of homage, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 3:6 And if his gift be a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord from the flock, whether it be a male or a female, he shall offer it without blemish.
LEV 3:7 If he bring a lamb as his gift he shall bring it before the Lord
LEV 3:8 and lay his hands on the head of his gift and kill it at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony, and the sons of Aaron the priest shall pour the blood on the altar round about.
LEV 3:9 And from the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer as an offering of homage to the Lord the fat tail and the whole loin which he shall take off with the rump; and having taken off the caul which covereth the inwards and all the fat on the belly
LEV 3:10 and the two kidneys with the suet on them and on the loin and the lobe of the liver with the kidneys
LEV 3:11 the priest shall offer up these on the altar. It is a sweet savour, an offering of homage to the Lord.
LEV 3:12 And if his gift be from the goats, he shall bring it before the Lord
LEV 3:13 and lay his hands on its head, and they shall kill it before the Lord at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour out the blood against the altar round about;
LEV 3:14 And from it he shall offer up as an offering of homage to the Lord the caul which covereth the belly and all the fat on the belly
LEV 3:15 and both the kidneys and all the suet on them. That on the loins and the lobe of the liver he shall take off with the kidneys
LEV 3:16 and the priest shall offer them on the altar. It is an offering of homage, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 3:17 All the .suet for the Lord shall be an ordinance for ever throughout your generations. You shall not eat suet nor blood of any kind.
LEV 4:1 Again the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
LEV 4:2 Speak to the children of Israel and say, When any person sinneth unwittingly before the Lord, and doth any of those things, which by any of the commandments of the Lord he ought not to do;
LEV 4:3 if for instance the chief priest who hath been anointed, sin; on the account of his causing the people to sin, he shall, for the sin which he hath committed, bring a young bull without blemish from the herd before the Lord for his sin offering;
LEV 4:4 and having brought the young bull to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord he shall lay his hand on the head of the young bull before the Lord and slay the bull in the presence of the Lord;
LEV 4:5 And the priest who is anointed, he whose hands have been consecrated, having taken some of the blood of the bull shall carry it into the tabernacle of the testimony.
LEV 4:6 And this priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord, before the holy veil;
LEV 4:7 and he shall put some of the blood of the bull on the horns of the altar of compound incense, which is before the Lord in the tabernacle of the testimony. Now all the blood of the bull he is to pour out at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings which is at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony.
LEV 4:8 And with regard to all the suet of the bull for the sin offering, he shall strip off the caul, which covereth the entrails and all the fat on the entrails
LEV 4:9 and the two kidneys with the suet on them; that which is on the loins and the lobe which is on the liver he shall strip off with the two kidneys in the same manner
LEV 4:10 as it is to be taken from the young bull of the sacrifice of thanksgiving; and the priest shall offer up these upon the altar of homage offerings:
LEV 4:11 but the skin of the bull and all his flesh with the head and the limbs and the belly and the dung
LEV 4:12 even the whole bull they shall carry forth without the camp to a clean place where the ashes are emptied out, and burn him on wood with fire. On the out pourings of the ashes he shall be burned.
LEV 4:13 And if the whole congregation of Israel be unwittingly ignorant and a commandment hath escaped the notice of the whole congregation, and they shall do an act, which by any of the commandments of the Lord ought not to be done and shall transgress:
LEV 4:14 when the sin which they have thereby committed is made known to them, the congregation shall bring a young bull from the herd without blemish for their sin offering; and when they have brought him to the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony,
LEV 4:15 the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the Lord and slay the bull before the Lord;
LEV 4:16 and the priest, the anointed one shall carry some of the blood of the bull into the tabernacle of the testimony;
LEV 4:17 and the priest shall dip his linger into some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord in front of the holy veil,
LEV 4:18 and shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of compound incense which is before the Lord in the tabernacle of the testimony. Now all the blood he is to pour out at the base of the altar of homage offerings which is at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
LEV 4:19 Then he shall take off all the suet of the victim and carry it up upon the altar
LEV 4:20 and shall do with this bull in the same manner as was done with the bull for the sin offering. This being done the priest shall make atonement for them, and the sin shall be forgiven them.
LEV 4:21 But they must carry forth the whole bull out of the camp and burn him as they did the former bull. It is a sin offering of the congregation.
LEV 4:22 And if the chief sin or do inadvertently any of those things which by the commands of the Lord his God ought not to be done and commit sin or trespass;
LEV 4:23 when the sin which he hath thereby committed is made known to him he shall bring as his gift a goat from the goats a male without blemish,
LEV 4:24 and he shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and they shall kill it in the place where they kill the whole burnt offerings before the Lord. It is a sin offering.
LEV 4:25 And the priest with his finger shall put some of the blood of this sin offering on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings. Now all the blood thereof he is to pour out at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings
LEV 4:26 and he shall offer all the suet thereof on the altar as he did the suet of the sacrifice of thanksgiving. So the priest shall make atonement for him because of the sins which he hath committed and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 4:27 And if any of the people of the land sin inadvertently by doing any of those things which by the commands of the Lord ought not to be done and shall transgress;
LEV 4:28 when the sin which he hath thereby committed is made known to him, he shall bring a goat from the goats; he shall bring a she goat without blemish for the sin which he hath committed
LEV 4:29 and shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering; and they shall kill this she goat for his sin offering in the place where they kill the whole burnt offerings.
LEV 4:30 And the priest shall take some of the blood thereof with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings. Now all the blood thereof he is to pour out at the base of the altar.
LEV 4:31 And he shall strip off all the suet in the same manner as suet is stripped from a sacrifice of thanksgiving; and the priest shall offer it on the altar for a smell of fragrance for the Lord. So shall the priest make atonement for him and he shall be forgiven.
LEV 4:32 And if he bring a sheep as his gift for his sin offering, he shall bring a ewe without blemish,
LEV 4:33 and lay his hand on the head of the sin offering; and they shall kill it in the place where they kill the whole burnt offerings;
LEV 4:34 and the priest having taken up with his finger some of the blood of the sin offering shall put it on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings. Now all the blood thereof he is to pour out at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings:
LEV 4:35 and he shall strip off all its suet in the same manner as the suet is stripped from the sheep for a sacrifice of thanksgiving; and the priest shall lay it on the altar on the whole burnt offering of the Lord. So shall the priest make atonement for him and he shall be forgiven.
LEV 5:1 And when any person shall sin inadvertently; now should one be adjured and being a witness hath either seen or known, if he do not tell, he will contract that sin;
LEV 5:2 or if any person touch any unclean thing, either a corpse, or the unclean prey of wild beasts, or the carcases of unclean abominations, or the carcases of unclean beasts,
LEV 5:3 or shall touch any impurity of man; any of his impurities by the touching of which one would be defiled, and it escaped his notice and he hath afterwards come to the knowledge of it;
LEV 5:4 or if a person be a transgressor, either pronouncing with his lips to do evil; or to do good according to all that the man might pronounce with an oath and it hath escaped his notice; when he hath come to the knowledge of his having inadvertently sinned in any of these cases,
LEV 5:5 he shall confess his sin in respect to whatever he hath sinned;
LEV 5:6 and for trespassing against the Lord, for the sin which he hath sinned, he shall bring a female from the flock either a lamb or a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he hath sinned; and the sin shall be forgiven him.
LEV 5:7 And if he is not able to furnish a lamb, he shall bring for the trespass which he hath committed two turtle doves or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for a sin offering and the other for a whole burnt offering:
LEV 5:8 and he shall carry them to the priest and the priest shall offer that for the sin offering, first. And the priest shall wring off its head from the neck, but shall not divide it;
LEV 5:9 and he shall sprinkle some of the blood of that which is for a sin offering on the side of the altar and squeeze out the rest of the blood on the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.
LEV 5:10 Then he shall offer the other as an offering of homage in the usual manner. So shall the priest make atonement for him for the sin which he hath committed and it shall be forgiven him.
LEV 5:11 But if his hand cannot find a pair of doves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his gift for the sin which he hath committed the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. Upon this he shall not pour oil, nor shall he lay incense on it, because it is a sin offering.
LEV 5:12 And he shall bring it to the priest; and the priest having taken his handful from it shall lay this memorial of it on the altar of whole burnt offerings for the Lord. It is a sin offering.
LEV 5:13 So shall the priest make atonement for him, for the sin which he hath committed and it shall be forgiven him. And what is left shall be for the priest, as the sacrifice of fine flour.
LEV 5:14 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
LEV 5:15 If a person through inadvertence hath forgotten or been unwittingly deficient in any of the holy things of the Lord; when he shall bring for his trespass against the Lord a ram without blemish from the flock, thou must estimate in silver shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, the value of that in respect to which he hath trespassed,
LEV 5:16 and he shall pay the amount of the deficiency of which he hath been guilty, and shall add thereto a fifth and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the trespass ram and he shall be forgiven.
LEV 5:17 So with respect to every person, who may have sinned; when he shall do any of those things, which by any of the commands of the Lord ought not to be done, and did not know; if he hath trespassed and contracted guilt;
LEV 5:18 when he shall bring a ram without blemish from the flock, thou must fine him in money before the priest to the amount of the trespass; and the priest shall make atonement for him, for the ignorance of which he was guilty, though he did not know; and he shall be forgiven;
LEV 5:19 for he hath been guilty of a trespass in the sight of the Lord.
LEV 6:1 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
LEV 6:2 With regard to the person who shall sin, and who, utterly disregarding the commands of the Lord, shall lie to his neighbour touching a deposit, or touching any thing which he might use in common, or touching any thing made a prey of, whether he hath defrauded his neighbour in any respect,
LEV 6:3 or hath found what was lost, and shall lie concerning it; or hath sworn falsely in respect to any of the things which he may have done, so as thereby to commit sin;
LEV 6:4 when he who hath thus sinned and transgressed hath restored the thing wrongfully taken, or that which he hath got unjustly, or the deposit which was committed to his trust, or the thing lost which he hath found;
LEV 6:5 then for every thing about which he hath sworn falsely he shall pay as a fine to the same amount, and add thereto a fifth. To him whose it is he shall make restoration on the day he is convicted.
LEV 6:6 And when for his trespass he shall bring for the Lord a ram from the flock without blemish, thou must fine him to the amount of his trespass.
LEV 6:7 Then the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord; and he shall be forgiven for every of those things which he hath done, and by which he hath trespassed.
LEV 6:8 Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:9 Give a charge to Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the whole burnt offering. The whole burnt offering must be burning on the altar the whole night until the morning, and the fire of the altar must be kept burning thereon. It must not be extinguished.
LEV 6:10 Then the priest shall put on a linen vesture, and around his body he shall put on linen drawers; and he shall take away the ashes, into which the fire hath consumed the whole burnt offering, from the altar, and lay them near the altar.
LEV 6:11 Then he shall put off his robe, and put on another robe, and he shall carry forth the ashes without the camp to a clean place.
LEV 6:12 And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning from itself, and shall not be extinguished. And the priest shall kindle wood upon it every morning, and shall lay the whole burnt offering in order upon it; and upon it he shall lay the suet of the offerings of thanksgiving.
LEV 6:13 So the fire shall be kept burning continually, and shall not be extinguished.
LEV 6:14 This is the law of the sacrifice of flour, which the sons of Aaron shall offer before the Lord, in front of the altar.
LEV 6:15 Having taken from it his handful of the flour of the sacrifice, with the oil of it, and all the frankincense which is on the sacrifice, he shall lay this memorial of it on the altar as an offering of homage, a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 6:16 And what is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the tabernacle of the testimony.
LEV 6:17 It shall not be baked with leaven. This portion I have given them from the homage offerings of the Lord. It is most holy, as is that of the sin offering, and as is that of the trespass offering.
LEV 6:18 Every male among the priests shall eat it. It shall be an everlasting ordinance throughout your generations, in respect to the homage offerings of the Lord, whoever shall touch them shall be hallowed.
LEV 6:19 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:20 This is the gift of Aaron and his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord, on the day when thou shalt anoint him, the tenth of the ephah of fine flour for a continual sacrifice; the half of it in the morning, and the half of it in the evening.
LEV 6:21 It shall be prepared in a pan with oil. Being mixed up, he shall offer it in rolls, as a sacrifice of fragments, for a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
LEV 6:22 The priest who is anointed, that one of his sons who is to succeed him shall prepare it. This is an everlasting ordinance, Let it be all consumed.
LEV 6:23 Indeed every sacrifice of a priest must be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.
LEV 6:24 Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 6:25 Speak to Aaron and his sons, and say, This is the law of the Sin offering. Wherever they kill the whole burnt offering, there they shall kill the sin offerings before the Lord. They are most holy.
LEV 6:26 The priest who carrieth it up shall eat it in a holy place. It shall be eaten in the court of the tabernacle of the testimony.
LEV 6:27 Every one who toucheth the flesh of it shall be hallowed. And if any of the blood of it shall be sprinkled on any one's garment, he who is sprinkled therewith shall be washed in a holy place.
LEV 6:28 And if it be boiled in an earthen vessel, the vessel shall be broken; but if it be boiled in a brasen vessel, they must scour it and rinse it with water.
LEV 6:29 Every male among the priests shall eat thereof. It is most holy to the Lord.
LEV 6:30 But none of the sin offerings, some of the blood of which hath been carried into the tabernacle of the testimony, to make an atonement in the sanctuary, shall be eaten. They must be burned with fire.
LEV 7:1 And this is the law of the ram for a trespass offering. It is most holy.
LEV 7:2 In the place where they kill the whole burnt offerings, they shall kill the ram for a trespass offering before the Lord; and his blood shall be poured on the base of the altar all around:
LEV 7:3 and of it shall be offered up the whole fat tail, and loin, and all the caul which covereth the entrails, and all the suet on the entrails,
LEV 7:4 and the two kidneys with the suet on them. That on the loins, and the lobe which is on the liver, shall be stript off with the kidneys.
LEV 7:5 And the priest shall carry them up upon the altar as an offering of homage to the Lord. It is a trespass offering.
LEV 7:6 Every male among the priests shall eat there of. They shall eat it in a holy place. It is most holy.
LEV 7:7 As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering. There is one law for both: The priest who shall make atonement with it shall have it.
LEV 7:8 And the priest who offereth any man's whole burnt offering shall have the skin of the whole burnt offering which he offereth.
LEV 7:9 And every sacrifice of flour which shall be prepared in the oven, and every one which shall be baked on the hearth, or in a pan, shall be the priest's who offereth it:
LEV 7:10 and every sacrifice of flour, whether made up with oil or not, shall be for all the sons of Aaron, for one as much as another.
LEV 7:11 This is the law of the sacrifice of thanksgiving which they shall offer to the Lord:
LEV 7:12 If one offereth it for praise, he shall bring with the sacrifice of praise loaves of fine flour make up with oil, and unleavened cakes anointed with oil, and fine flour tempered with oil.
LEV 7:13 With loaves of leavened bread he shall present these gifts of his for a sacrifice of praise and thanksgiving;
LEV 7:14 and from every of these gifts of his he shall set apart one, and present it as a dedication to the Lord. It shall be for the priest who poureth out the blood of the victim offered for thanksgiving.
LEV 7:15 And the flesh of the victim of praise and thanksgiving shall be for himself, and shall be eaten on the day it is offered. They shall not leave any of it till the morning.
LEV 7:16 And if it be a vow; or if one offer his gift as a voluntary sacrifice, it shall be eaten on the day he offereth his sacrifice, or the next morning.
LEV 7:17 And what is left of the flesh of the sacrifice till the third day shall be burned with fire.
LEV 7:18 And if any one eat of the flesh on the third day, it shall not be accepted for him who offereth it. It shall not be placed to his account. It is an abomination. Whoever shall eat it shall contract guilt.
LEV 7:19 If any flesh touch any unclean thing, it shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. Every person who is clean may eat flesh.
LEV 7:20 But if any person shall eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of thanksgiving, which is the Lord's, with his uncleanness upon him, that person shall be cut off from among his people.
LEV 7:21 And the person who shall touch any unclean thing, whether it be the uncleanness of a man, or of unclean beasts, or any unclean abomination, and shall eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of thanksgiving, which is the Lord's, that person shall be destroyed from among his people.
LEV 7:22 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 7:23 Speak to the children of Israel, and say, You shall not eat any suet of cattle, nor of sheep, nor of goats.
LEV 7:24 The suet of beasts which die of themselves, or which are torn by wild beasts, may be used for any kind of work; but shall not be eaten for food.
LEV 7:25 Whoever eateth of the suet of cattle of which he is to make an offering of homage to the Lord, that person shall be cut off from among his people.
LEV 7:26 You shall not eat any blood in any of your dwellings, neither the blood of cattle, nor of fowls.
LEV 7:27 Whoever shall eat blood, that person shall be cut off from among his people.
LEV 7:28 The Lord also spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV 7:29 Thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, and say, He who offereth a sacrifice of thanksgiving shall bring his gift to the Lord; and from the sacrifice of thanksgiving
LEV 7:30 his own hands shall present, as his offerings of homage to the Lord, the suet, with the breast, and the lobe of the liver. These he shall present that they may be laid before the Lord as a gift.
LEV 7:31 And the priest shall offer up the suet on the altar; and the breast shall be for Aaron and his sons.
LEV 7:32 You shall also give the right shoulder, as a portion dedicated and set apart for the priest, from your sacrifices of thanksgiving.
LEV 7:33 That one of the sons of Aaron who offereth the blood of the thank offering, and the suet, shall have the right shoulder for his portion.
LEV 7:34 For the breast which is dedicated by being laid upon hands, and the shoulder which is dedicated by being set apart, I have taken from the children of Israel; from your sacrifices of thanksgiving; and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons. It is an everlasting due from the children of Israel.
LEV 7:35 This is the unction of Aaron and the unction of his sons, the reward assigned them from the homage offerings of the Lord, on the day he took them into his house to minister to the Lord in the priest's office;
LEV 7:36 and which the Lord commanded to be given them on the day he anointed them from among the children of Israel, as an everlasting due throughout their generations.
LEV 7:37 This is the law of the whole burnt offering and the sacrifice of flour, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering and of the consecration offering and of the sacrifice of thanksgiving,
LEV 7:38 as the Lord commanded Moses at mount Sina, on the day when he commanded the children of Israel to bring their gifts before the Lord in the wilderness of Sina.
LEV 8:1 Then the 'Lord spoke to Moses saying,
LEV 8:2 Take Aaron and his sons, and his robes and the anointing oil, and the young bull for the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened cakes;
LEV 8:3 and assemble all the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
LEV 8:4 And Moses did as the Lord commanded him. And when he had assembled the congregation at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony,
LEV 8:5 Moses said to the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded to be done.
LEV 8:6 Then Moses brought forward Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
LEV 8:7 Then he arrayed him with the vesture, and girded him with the oracle and put on him the under robe, and over it he put on the ephod, and girded him with the girdle of the same fabrick as the ephod, and bound him up tight with it,
LEV 8:8 and put on it the oracle; and upon the oracle he put the manifestation and the truth.
LEV 8:9 Then he put the mitre on his head; and on the mitre, on the front of it, he put the golden plate, the holy sanctified jewel as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 8:10 Then Moses took some of the anointing oil, and sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and anointed the altar, and hallowed it and all its appurtenances, and the laver and its base.
LEV 8:11 And when he had hallowed them he anointed the tabernacle, and all the utensils thereof, and hallowed it.
LEV 8:12 Then Moses poured some of the anointing oil on the head of Aaron. And when he had anointed him, and hallowed him,
LEV 8:13 then Moses brought forward the sons of Aaron, and arrayed them with vestures, and girded them with girdles, and put tiaras on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 8:14 Then Moses brought forward the young bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the young bull for the sin offering;
LEV 8:15 and he slew it, and Moses took some of the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar. Then he poured out the blood on the base of the altar. And when he had hallowed it to make an atonement upon it
LEV 8:16 , then Moses took all the suet on the entrails, and the lobe which is on the liver, and both the kidneys with the suet on them, and carried them up upon the altar;
LEV 8:17 but the bull, and his hide, and his flesh, and his dung, these he caused to be burned with fire without the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 8:18 Then Moses brought forward the ram which was for a whole burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram;
LEV 8:19 and Moses slew the ram, and poured the blood against the altar round about.
LEV 8:20 And having divided the ram into quarters, Moses carried up the head, and the pieces, and the suet.
LEV 8:21 Then having washed the belly and the feet with water, Moses carried up the whole ram upon the altar. It is a whole burnt offering for a smell of fragrance; an offering of homage to the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 8:22 Then Moses brought forward the other ram, which was for a consecration offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of this ram,
LEV 8:23 and he slew it. And Moses took some of the blood thereof, and put it on the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
LEV 8:24 Then Moses brought forward the sons of Aaron, and put some of the blood on the tips of their right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the great toes of their right feet. He then poured the blood against the altar round about.
LEV 8:25 And he took the tail, and the loin, and the suet on the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys with the suet on them, and the right shoulder;
LEV 8:26 and from the basket of the consecration offering, which was before the Lord, he took one unleavened loaf, and one loaf of oil bread, and one cake, and laid them on the suet and the right shoulder,
LEV 8:27 and put them all on the hands of Aaron, and on the hands of his sons, and caused them to be lifted up as a dedication before the Lord.
LEV 8:28 Then Moses took them from their hands, and carried them up upon the altar; on the consecration whole burnt offering, which is for a smell of fragrance. It is an offering of homage to the Lord.
LEV 8:29 Then having taken the breast, Moses set this, which had been laid on hands before the Lord, apart from the ram of the consecration offering. And it was Moses' portion, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 8:30 Then Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was by the altar, and sprinkled them on Aaron and his robes, and on his sons and their robes with him. And when he had hallowed Aaron and his robes, and his sons and their robes with him,
LEV 8:31 then Moses said to Aaron and his sons, Boil this flesh in the court of the tabernacle of the testimony, in a holy place, and eat it there with the bread which is in the basket of the consecration offering, as it hath been given me in charge, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat these.
LEV 8:32 And what is left of the flesh, and of the bread, you must burn with fire.
LEV 8:33 And from the door of the tabernacle of the testimony you shall not depart for seven days, until the day be compleated; the day of your consecration; for he will consecrate your hands seven days,
LEV 8:34 as he hath done this very day, in which the Lord hath commanded me to do this in order to make an atonement for you.
LEV 8:35 You shall therefore continue seven days at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony. Day and night you shall keep the watches of the Lord, that you may not die; for so the Lord God hath commanded me.
LEV 8:36 And when Aaron and his sons had done all that the Lord commanded Moses,
LEV 9:1 On the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the senate of Israel,
LEV 9:2 and Moses said to Aaron, Take for thyself a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a whole burnt offering, both without blemish [Now he had brought them before the Lord]
LEV 9:3 and speak to the senate of Israel saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb of the first year for an homage offering, all without blemish,
LEV 9:4 and a young bull and a ram for a sacrifice of thanksgiving before the Lord, and fine flour tempered with oil; for to-day the Lord will appear among you.
LEV 9:5 And when they had brought them, as Moses commanded, over against the tabernacle of the testimony, and all the congregation were come, and stood before the Lord,
LEV 9:6 Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded; do it, and the glory of the Lord will appear among you.
LEV 9:7 Then Moses said to Aaron, Go near to the altar, and offer thy own sin offering, and thy own burnt offering, and make atonement for thyself and thy house, then offer the gifts of the people, and make atonement for them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 9:8 Accordingly Aaron went near to the altar, and slew the calf for his own sin offering, and the
LEV 9:9 sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and having poured out the blood on the base of the altar,
LEV 9:10 he carried up the suet, and the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver, of the sin offering, upon the altar as the Lord commanded Moses,
LEV 9:11 and the flesh and the skin he caused to be burned with fire without the camp.
LEV 9:12 Then he slew the whole burnt offering, and the sons of Aaron brought him the blood, and he poured it out against the altar round about.
LEV 9:13 Then they presented the whole burnt offering by pieces, and these and the head he laid on the altar.
LEV 9:14 He then washed the belly and the feet with water, and laid them on the whole burnt offering on the altar.
LEV 9:15 Then he brought forward the gift of the people, and he took the goat for the sin offering of the people, and slew it, and purified it as he had done the first.
LEV 9:16 He then brought forward the whole burnt offering, and did with it in the manner prescribed.
LEV 9:17 Then, presenting the sacrifice of flour, he filled his hands with some of it, and laid the handful on the altar apart from the morning whole burnt offering.
LEV 9:18 Then he slew the young bull and the ram for the people's sacrifice of thanksgiving; and the sons of Aaron brought him the blood; and he poured it out against the altar round about.
LEV 9:19 And the suet of the bull and that of the ram with the loin and the caul which covereth the belly, and the two kidneys with the suet on them, and the lobe of the liver;
LEV 9:20 the several parcels of suet he laid on the breast, and having carried up the suet upon the altar,
LEV 9:21 Aaron took away the breast and the right shoulder as a portion set apart before the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 9:22 Then Aaron, lifting up his hands over the people, blessed them; When he came down from offering the sin offering, and the whole burnt offerings, and the offerings of thanksgiving,
LEV 9:23 and Moses and Aaron had gone into the tabernacle of the testimony, and come out and blessed all the people, then the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people,
LEV 9:24 and there came forth a fire from the Lord which consumed what were on the altar, both the whole burnt offerings and the parcels of suet. And when all the people saw this, they were struck with consternation and fell on their faces;
LEV 10:1 and the two sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abiud, having taken each his censer, laid fire on it, and threw incense thereon, and presented before the Lord strange fire, which the Lord had not ordered them;
LEV 10:2 upon which a fire darted forth from the Lord, and destroyed them, and they died before the Lord.
LEV 10:3 Whereupon Moses said to Aaron, This is what the Lord spoke, saying, I will be hallowed by them who come near me, and glorified by all the congregation; and Aaron was pierced with anguish.
LEV 10:4 Then Moses called Misado and Elisaphan, the sons of Oziel, the sons of Aaron's uncle, and said to them, Go near and carry out your brethren from before  the holies, out of the camp.
LEV 10:5 So they went near, and carried them, in their vestures, out of the camp, as Moses ordered.
LEV 10:6 Then Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar, and Ithamar, his surviving sons, Uncover not your heads, nor rend your garments, lest you die, and wrath come on the whole congregation: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail this burning with which the Lord hath burned them.
LEV 10:7 But you must not go from the door of the tabernacle of the testimony lest you die; for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. So they did according to the command of Moses.
LEV 10:8 And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,
LEV 10:9 Thou, and thy sons with thee, must not drink wine nor strong drink, when you come into the tabernacle of the testimony, or when you approach the altar, lest you die. It is your everlasting privilege, throughout your generations,
LEV 10:10 to distinguish between holy things and things unholy, and between clean and unclean things,
LEV 10:11 and to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord hath delivered them by the ministration of Moses.
LEV 10:12 Then Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar, and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron, who were left, Take the sacrifice of flour which was left from the homage offerings of the Lord, and eat the unleavened bread near the altar. It is most holy;
LEV 10:13 therefore you must eat it in a holy place; for this is thy due, and thy sons due, from the homage offerings of the Lord: for so it hath been given me in charge.
LEV 10:14 The dedicated breast, and the dedicated shoulder, which are set apart, you shall eat in a holy place, thou, and thy sons, and thy household with thee, for it hath been given thee as thy due, and to thy sons as their due from the thank offerings of the children of Israel.
LEV 10:15 The dedicated shoulder, and the dedicated breast, they shall offer on the homage offerings of suet, to be set apart as a dedication before the Lord; and they shall be for thee, and for thy sons, and for thy daughters with thee, an everlasting due, as the Lord commanded Moses.
LEV 10:16 Now when Moses made diligent search for the goat of the sin offering, and behold it was burned, Moses was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, and said,
LEV 10:17 Why did you not eat the sin offering in a holy place? for because it is most holy, he hath given this to you to eat, that you may take away the sin of the congregation, and make atonement for them before the Lord;
LEV 10:18 for none of its blood was carried into the sanctuary. You should have eaten it publicly in the court, in a holy place, as the Lord commanded me.
LEV 10:19 Upon this Aaron spoke to Moses, saying, Though they have this day brought their sin offerings and their whole burnt offerings before the Lord; yet such things having befallen me, had I this day eaten their sin offering, would it have been well pleasing to the Lord?
LEV 10:20 Upon hearing this Moses was satisfied with him.
LEV 11:1 Again the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
LEV 11:2 Speak to the children of Israel, and say, Among all the beasts which are on the earth, these are the beasts which you may eat.
LEV 11:3 Every beast having a double hoof, its hoof parted into two distinct hoofs, and bringing up the cud, these among the beasts you may eat.
LEV 11:4 But of these you shall not eat; of those which chew the cud, and of those which have parted hoofs; the camel, though it cheweth the cud; yet because it hath not a parted hoof, it is unclean to you;
LEV 11:5 the hairy foot, though it cheweth the cud, yet because it hath not a parted hoof, it is unclean to you;
LEV 11:6 and the choirogryllus, though it cheweth the cud, yet because it hath not a parted hoof, it is unclean to you;
LEV 11:7 and the swine, though it hath a parted hoof, yet because it doth not chew the cud, it is unclean to you.
LEV 11:8 Of the flesh of these you shall not eat; nor shall you touch their dead carcases. They are unclean to you.
LEV 11:9 And these are what you may eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales, in the waters or in the seas or in the brooks, these you may eat;
