NUM 16:12 Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiron, the sons of Eliab; but they said we will not go up.
NUM 16:13 Is it a small matter that thou hast been bringing us up to a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in this wilderness, that thou tyrannisest over us?
NUM 16:14 Thou art a chief! And thou hast brought us to a land flowing with milk and honey! and hast given us a portion of land, and vineyards! Fain wouldst thou put out the eyes of these men! We will not go up.
NUM 16:15 Upon this Moses was greatly incensed, and said to the Lord, Respect not their sacrifice. I have not taken from any of them an object of desire, nor have I injured any of them.
NUM 16:16 Then Moses said to Kore, Hallow thy company and be ready before the Lord, thou and Aaron and they, to morrow.
NUM 16:17 And take every one his censer, and put incense thereon, and present before the Lord, every one, his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also and Aaron, each his censer.
NUM 16:18 And when every one had taken his censer, and put fire therein, and laid incense on it, and Moses and Aaron stood at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony;
NUM 16:19 and Kore had collected against them all his company, at the doors of the tabernacle of the testimony, the glory of the Lord appeared to the whole congregation.
NUM 16:20 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron saying,
NUM 16:21 Separate yourselves from among this congregation, and I will consume them all at once.
NUM 16:22 At this they fell on their faces and said, God, the God of the spirits even of all flesh! If one man hath sinned, is the wrath of the Lord against the whole congregation?
NUM 16:23 Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 16:24 Speak to the congregation, and say, Withdraw all around from the congregation of Kore.
NUM 16:25 Accordingly Moses, arose, and went to Dathan and Abiron; and all the elders of Israel accompanied him.
NUM 16:26 And he spoke to the congregation, saying, Separate yourselves from the tents of these wicked men, and touch not any of the things which belong to them, lest you be consumed with them in their sins.
NUM 16:27 And when they had drawn back, all around, from the tent of Kore, Dathan and Abiron came out, and stood at the doors of their tents, with their wives and their children, and their attendants.
NUM 16:28 And Moses said, By this you shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works, and that they are not of myself;
NUM 16:29 If these men die the common death of all men; or if their visitation be according to the visitation of all men, the Lord hath not sent me:
NUM 16:30 but if the Lord demonstrate by a miracle, and the earth opening its mouth, shall swallow up them and their households, and their tents, and all that belong to them; and they go down alive to the mansion of the dead; then you will know that these men have provoked the Lord.
NUM 16:31 And when he had made an end of speaking all these words, the earth was rent under them;
NUM 16:32 and the earth opened; and it swallowed up them, and their households, and all the men who were with Kore, and all their cattle.
NUM 16:33 And they, and all that belonged to them, went down alive to the mansions of the dead, and the earth covered them. And they were destroyed from among the congregation.
NUM 16:34 And all the Israelites who were around them fled at their cry; for they said, Perhaps the earth may swallow us up.
NUM 16:35 And there went forth a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men, who were offering incense!
NUM 16:36 Then the Lord said to Moses,
NUM 16:37 and to Eleazar the priest, the son of Aaron, Gather up the brasen censers from among them who were burned; but as for the strange fire, scatter it there
NUM 16:38 Because they have hallowed the censers of these sinful men with their lives, therefore make them up into thin plates, as a cover for the altar. Because they were presented before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed, and made a sign for the children of Israel.
NUM 16:39 So Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, took the brasen censers which they who were burned up had presented; and of them made a cover for the altar,
NUM 16:40 a memorial to the children of Israel, that none of another family, who is not of the seed of Aaron, should come near to present incense before the Lord, lest he be like Kore, and his confederacy, as the Lord spoke to him by the ministry of Moses.
NUM 16:41 On the next day, when the people murmured against Moses and Aaron, saying, You have slain the people of the Lord;
NUM 16:42 when, in their insurrection against Moses and Aaron, the congregation were rushing upon the tabernacle of the testimony, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared:
NUM 16:43 And Moses went in, with Aaron, in front of the tabernacle of the testimony,
NUM 16:44 and the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
NUM 16:45 Withdraw from among this congregation, and I will destroy them all at once.
NUM 16:46 Whereupon they fell on their face. And Moses said to Aaron, Take the censer, and put therein fire from the altar, and throw incense on it, and carry it with all haste to the camp, and make atonement for them; for wrath is gone forth from the presence of the Lord, and hath begun to slay the people.
NUM 16:47 So Aaron took as Moses commanded him, and ran into the congregation; [Now the destruction among the people had already begun] and he threw on the incense, and made atonement for the people,
NUM 16:48 and stood between the dead and the living; and the plague ceased.
NUM 16:49 Now they who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died on the account of Kore.
NUM 16:50 When Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony, and the plague had ceased,
NUM 17:1 the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 17:2 Speak to the children of Israel, and take of them a staff; a staff for every house of patriarchal families; from all the chiefs of the respective houses of patriarchal families twelve staves; and write every one's name on his staff;
NUM 17:3 and on the staff of Levi write Aaron's name; for he is one staff. The chief of the house of the head family in every tribe shall give;
NUM 17:4 and thou shalt lay them in the tabernacle of the testimony, over against the testimony. By these I will there make myself known to thee;
NUM 17:5 and it shall come to pass, that the staff of the man whom I will chuse, shall bloom: and I will remove from me this murmuring of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.
NUM 17:6 So Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and all the chiefs gave him, every one a staff; for every chief a staff, according to the houses of their patriarchal families, twelve staves, with Aaron's staff among theirs.
NUM 17:7 And Moses laid the staves before the Lord in the tabernacle of the testimony.
NUM 17:8 And on the next day when Moses went in, with Aaron, into the tabernacle of the testimony, behold Aaron's staff, for the house of Levi, had bloomed, and brought forth a bud, and had shot forth blossoms, and produced almonds.
NUM 17:9 And Moses brought out all the staves from the presence of the Lord, before all the children of Israel. And when they saw and had taken, every one his staff,
NUM 17:10 the Lord said to Moses, Lay up Aaron's staff again before the testimonies, to be kept as a sign for the children of these rebellious men; and let their murmuring cease from me that they may not die.
NUM 17:11 So Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded Moses.
NUM 17:12 And when they had done so, the sons of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, Behold, we have been wasted, we have been destroyed, we have been cut off suddenly;
NUM 17:13 every one who toucheth the tabernacle of the Lord dieth. Must we all die?
NUM 18:1 whereupon the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying, Thou, and thy sons, and the house of thy father, shall bear the sins of the holy things; and thou, and thy sons, shall bear the sins of your priesthood;
NUM 18:2 take therefore to thyself thy brethren, the tribe of Levi, the community of thy father, and let them be joined to thee, and perform holy service for thee. While thou, and thy sons with thee, are before the tabernacle of the testimony,
NUM 18:3 they shall keep guard for thee, and guard the tabernacle of the testimony: but let them not approach to the holy utensils, nor to the altar, lest they die, and you with them.
NUM 18:4 They shall be joined with thee, and shall keep guard over the tabernacle of the testimony, according to all the holy services of the tabernacle, and none of another family shall come to thee.
NUM 18:5 And you shall keep the charge of the holy things, and of the altar, so that there shall not be wrath among the children of Israel.
NUM 18:6 I have indeed taken your brethren, the Levites, from among the children of Israel, as a gift presented to the Lord to perform the services of the tabernacle of the testimony;
NUM 18:7 therefore thou, and thy sons with thee, shall keep your priesthood, as far as the altar is concerned, and what is within the veil; and you shall perform these services as a privilege of your priesthood; and any one of another family who approacheth shall be put to death.
NUM 18:8 Moreover the Lord said to Aaron, Behold I have given you the charge of the separated portions taken from all the dedications made to me by the children of Israel. To thee I have given them for a reward; and to thy sons after thee.
NUM 18:9 Let this therefore be your perpetual due from the hallowed dedications of the homage offerings; from all their gifts, and from all their sacrifices, and from all their trespass offerings, and from all their sin offerings. Whatever they give me, a portion of the hallowed things shall be for thee and thy sons.
NUM 18:10 In the holy place of the holies you shall eat them. Every male, namely, thou and thy sons shall eat them.
NUM 18:11 They shall be hallowed to thee. You shall have also a portion from the dedications which the Israelites make by setting apart, and from all the dedications made by being laid on hands; These I have given to thee, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee, as an everlasting due. Every one in thy house, who is clean, may eat these.
NUM 18:12 Every dedication of oil, and every dedication of wine, every dedication of food of all kinds which they give to the Lord, these I have given to thee.
NUM 18:13 All the first fruits in their land, which they bring for the Lord, shall belong to thee. Every one in thy house, who is clean, may eat these.
NUM 18:14 Every thing which is devoted by the children of Israel shall belong to thee.
NUM 18:15 And every firstling of all flesh, which they bring for the Lord, whether of man or beast, shall belong to thee: but the first born of man shall be redeemed, and thou shalt cause them to redeem the firstlings of all cattle which are not clean.
NUM 18:16 Now the redemption of the former, at a month old, shall be the set price of five shekels after the holy shekel, which is twenty oboli:
NUM 18:17 but the firstlings of kine, and the firstlings of sheep, and the firstlings of goats, thou shalt not suffer them to redeem. They are hallowed; therefore thou shalt pour out their blood before the altar, and offer their suet as an offering of homage, for a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
NUM 18:18 And the flesh shall be for thee. Like the dedicated breast, and like the right shoulder, it shall be thine.
NUM 18:19 Every dedication of holy things, which the children of Israel set apart for the Lord, I have given to thee, and thy sons, and thy daughters, as an everlasting due. It is a covenant of salt for ever, before the Lord, with thee and thy seed after thee.
NUM 18:20 Moreover the Lord said to Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, nor shalt thou have a portion among them; for I am thy portion, and thy inheritance, among the children of Israel.
NUM 18:21 And behold I have given the Levites all the tenth in Israel, as a portion for their services. Inasmuch as they are to perform service at the tabernacle of the testimony,
NUM 18:22 and the children of Israel are no more to come to the tabernacle of  the testimony, to bear a sin which incurreth death,
NUM 18:23 but the Levites themselves are to perform the service of the tabernacle, and to bear their sins, this shall be a perpetual due for their generations, and they shall have no inheritance among the children of Israel.
NUM 18:24 Because I have given the Levites for their portion the tithes of the children of Israel, which they set apart for the Lord, as a dedication, therefore I have said to them, they shall have no lot of inheritance among the Israelites.
NUM 18:25 Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 18:26 Thou shalt speak to the Levites and say to them; When you take from the children of Israel the tenth which I have given you from them for a lot of inheritance, you shall set apart from it, as a dedication for the Lord, a tenth of the tenth;
NUM 18:27 and these dedications of yours shall be reckoned to you as corn from the threshing floor, and as a dedication from the press.
NUM 18:28 Thus you shall acquit yourselves of all the dedications of the Lord; of all your tenths which you receive from the children of Israel. And you shall give the dedication set apart from it for the Lord to Aaron the priest.
NUM 18:29 From all your gifts you shall set apart a dedication for the Lord, and from all the first fruits, the hallowed  part of it.
NUM 18:30 Moreover thou shalt say unto them, When you set apart the first fruits of it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as produce from the threshing floor, and as produce from the press.
NUM 18:31 And you may eat it every where, you and your households. Because it is your wages for your services which you perform at the tabernacle of the testimony;
NUM 18:32 therefore you shall not bear sin by reason of it, because you have set apart the first fruits of it. But you must not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, lest you die.
NUM 19:1 Again the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
NUM 19:2 This is the purification of the law in respect to all the things which the Lord hath enjoined, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, and let them bring thee a red heifer, without blemish, which hath no spot in her, and on which there hath never been put a yoke.
NUM 19:3 And thou shalt give her to Eleazar the priest; and they shall lead her out of the camp, to a clean place, and kill her in his presence.
NUM 19:4 And Eleazar shall take some of the blood thereof, and shall sprinkle, over against the front of the tabernacle of the testimony, some of the blood thereof seven times.
NUM 19:5 Then they shall burn her in his sight; and when her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, and dung, are burned,
NUM 19:6 the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet yarn, and throw them into the midst of the cinders of the heifer.
NUM 19:7 Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and wash his whole body with water, and, after that, he shall come into
NUM 19:8 the camp. And the priest shall be unclean until the evening. And he who burned her shall wash his clothes, and wash his body with water, and be unclean until evening.
NUM 19:9 And a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them without the camp, in a clean place, and water of sprinkling shall be kept in store for the congregation of Israel. It is a purification.
NUM 19:10 And he who gathereth up the ashes of the heifer, shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. And it shall be for the children of Israel, and for the proselytes who have joined them, an everlasting ordinance,
NUM 19:11 that whoever toucheth the dead body of a man shall be unclean seven days.
NUM 19:12 He shall be purified on the third, and on the seventh day, then he shall be clean: but if he be not purified on the third, and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
NUM 19:13 If any person, who hath touched the dead, die, without being purified, he hath defiled the tabernacle of the Lord; that soul shall be blotted out from among Israel. Because the water of sprinkling bath not been sprinkled on him, he is unclean. His impurity is still in him.
NUM 19:14 This also is the law, that if any man die in a house, every one who goeth into the house, and all the things in the house, shall be unclean seven days.
NUM 19:15 And every open vessel which hath not a cover fastened on it, is unclean.
NUM 19:16 And every one who, in the open field, toucheth one slain, or dead, or a human bone, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
NUM 19:17 Now, for one who is unclean, they shall take some of the burnt ashes of the purification, and pour spring water thereon, in a vessel;
NUM 19:18 and a man who is clean shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the house, and on the vessels, and on the persons who may be in the house, and on him who hath touched a human bone, or a man who hath been slain, or one dead, or a grave.
NUM 19:19 The clean person shall sprinkle it on the unclean, on the third day, and on the seventh day. And on the seventh day he shall purify himself^ and shall wash his clothes, and wash himself with water, and be unclean until evening.
NUM 19:20 And whoever shall be defiled, and not purified, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation, because he hath defiled the holy things of the Lord. Because the water of sprinkling hath not been sprinkled on him, he is unclean.
NUM 19:21 And it shall be an everlasting statute for you, that he who sprinkleth the water of sprinkling, shall wash his clothes; and he who toucheth the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening:
NUM 19:22 and whatever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the person who toucheth it shall be unclean until evening.
NUM 20:1 When the children of Israel, the whole congregation, came to the wilderness of Sin, in the first month, the people took up their abode at Kades; and there Mariam died, and there she was buried.
NUM 20:2 And there being no water for the congregation, they assembled tumultuously against Moses and Aaron;
NUM 20:3 and the people reviled Moses, and said,! that we had died in the destruction of our brethren before the Lord!
NUM 20:4 Why have you brought the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, to kill us and our cattle?
NUM 20:5 Why is this? Have you brought us out of Egypt, that we might come to this vile place; a place where no seed can be sown, where there are no fig trees, nor vines, nor pomegranates, nor even water to drink?
NUM 20:6 Whereupon Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the congregation, to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony, and fell on their faces. And the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
NUM 20:7 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 20:8 Take thy staff, and assemble the congregation, thou, and Aaron thy brother; and speak to that rock before them, and it will give its water. And you shall bring water for them from that rock, and give drink to the congregation, and their cattle.
NUM 20:9 So Moses took the staff which was before the Lord, as the Lord commanded.
NUM 20:10 And Moses and Aaron assembled the congregation, at some distance over against the rock, and he said to them, Hear me, ye rebels! Can we bring water for you out of this rock?
NUM 20:11 Then Moses lifted up his hand, and smote the rock twice with the staff, and there gushed out much water, so that the congregation, and their cattle, drank.
NUM 20:12 Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because you have not believed, to sanctify me before the children of Israel, therefore you shall not lead this congregation into the land which I have given them.
NUM 20:13 This is the water of Strife, because the children of Israel uttered reproaches before the Lord, and he was hallowed among them.
NUM 20:14 Then Moses sent messengers from Kades, to the king of Edom, saying, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the trouble that hath befallen us.
NUM 20:15 Our fathers went down in 16 to Egypt, and we have sojourned in Egypt many years. And when the Egyptians ill treated us and our fathers,
NUM 20:16 we cried to the Lord, and the Lord hearkened to our voice; and having sent a messenger he hath brought us out of Egypt, and we are now at Kades, a city on the extremity of thy borders.
NUM 20:17 Let us pass through thy land. We will not march through the fields, nor vineyards, nor drink water out of thy cisterns. We will march along the king's high way, and will not turn aside to the right, nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
NUM 20:18 But Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass through me. If thou attempt it, I will come out to meet thee in battle.
NUM 20:19 Whereupon the children of Israel said, Let us pass through along the mountains, and if I, or my cattle drink of thy water, I will make thee compensation. Grant but this. It is but a small matter. Let us march through along the mountain.
NUM 20:20 But he said, Thou shalt not pass through me. And Edom came out to meet him with a great multitude, and a strong hand.
NUM 20:21 As Edom would not grant Israel a passage through his borders, therefore they turned aside from him;
NUM 20:22 and having removed from Kades, the Israelites; the whole congregation came to mount Hor.
NUM 20:23 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron at mount Hor, on the borders of the land of Edom, saying,
NUM 20:24 Let Aaron be gathered to his people. For you shall not enter the land which I have given the children of Israel for a possession, because you provoked me at the water of strife.
NUM 20:25 Take Aaron thy brother, and Eleazar his son, and make them go up to mount Hor,
NUM 20:26 in the view of the whole congregation, and strip Aaron of his robes, and put them on Eleazar his son: and let Aaron be composed, and die there.
NUM 20:27 So Moses did as the Lord commanded him; And having taken them up to mount Hor, in the view of the whole congregation,
NUM 20:28 he stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron died on the top of the mount. And Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
NUM 20:29 And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, the whole house of Israel mourned for Aaron thirty days.
NUM 21:1 When the Chananite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in front of the wilderness, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, he made war on Israel, and took some of them prisoners;
NUM 21:2 whereupon Israel vowed a vow to the Lord, and said, If thou wilt deliver this people into my hand, I will devote them and their cities to destruction.
NUM 21:3 And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up these Chananites into their hands, and they anathematised them and their cities, and called the name of that place Anathema.
NUM 21:4 Now when they had removed from mount Hor, by the way to the Red sea, and were marching round the land of Edom, the people became dispirited in the march,
NUM 21:5 and spoke against God, and against Moses, saying, Why hast thou brought us out of Egypt to kill us in this wilderness; for we have neither bread, nor water, and our soul loatheth this light food.
NUM 21:6 Whereupon the Lord sent the most deadly serpents among the people, and they bit the people. And when many of the children of Israel died,
NUM 21:7 the people came to Moses and said, We have sinned, because we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray therefore to the Lord? and let him take away the serpents from us.
NUM 21:8 So Moses prayed to the Lord for the people, and the Lord said to Moses, Make thee a serpent, and put it on a standard; and it shall come to pass that when a serpent biteth a man, every one who is bitten shall live by looking at that.
NUM 21:9 So Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it on a standard, and it came to pass that when a serpent bit a man, he looked up to that serpent, and lived.
NUM 21:10 And the Israelites removed, and encamped at Oboth;
NUM 21:11 and having removed from Oboth, they encamped at Achelgai, on the borders of the desart, which is in front of Moab, towards the rising of the sun.
NUM 21:12 And removing from that place, they encamped in the vale of Zared,
NUM 21:13 from which they removed, and encamped on the banks of Arnon, in the wilderness, on the borders of the Amorites; for Arnon is the boundary of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
NUM 21:14 For this cause it is said in a book, The war of the Lord burned Zoob and the vales of Arnon,
NUM 21:15 And made the vales the habitation of Er; And he adjoineth the borders of Moab.
NUM 21:16 Thence they came to Well; this is the well concerning which the Lord said to Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water to drink.
NUM 21:17 Then sung Israel this song to the well, Begin to him the alternate song of the well.
NUM 21:18 Chiefs digged it: the kings of nations hewed it out, In their reign when they ruled over them. And from Well they moved on to Manthanaiem;
NUM 21:19 and from Manthanaiem to Naaliel; and from Naaliel to Bamoth;
NUM 21:20 and from Bamoth to Nepe, which is in that plain of Moab bordering on the craggy cliff, namely, that which looketh towards the wilderness.
NUM 21:21 Now Moses had sent messengers to Seon, king of the Amorites, with a message of peace, saying,
NUM 21:22 Let us pass through thy land. We will march by the highway; we will not turn aside into the fields, nor into the vineyards; nor will we drink water out of thy; wells. Let us march along the king's highway. until we pass thy borders.
NUM 21:23 But Seon would not grant Israel a passage through his territories. He indeed assembled all his people, and went out to the wilderness, to attack Israel, and came to Jessa, and drew up in array against Israel.
NUM 21:24 Whereupon Israel smote him with the slaughter of the sword, and took possession of his land, from Anion to Jabok, even to the Ammanites; for Jazer is the boundary of the Ammanites.
NUM 21:25 So Israel took all those cities; and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Hesebon, and in all those under the same dominion with it;
NUM 21:26 for Hesebon was the city of Seon the king of the Amorites. He indeed had made war on a former king of Moab, and had taken all his land from Aroer to Arnon;
NUM 21:27 for this cause the poets say, Come to Hesebon that it may be rebuilded, And that the city of Seon may be inhabited.
NUM 21:28 For a fire went forth from Hesebon; And a flame from the city of Seon; Which devoured even to Moab; Which devoured the pillars of Arnon.
NUM 21:29 Alas! for thee Moab! Thou wast undone, people of Chamos! Their sons were delivered up to save their lives; And their daughters were captives to Seon, king of the Amorites,
NUM 21:30 And their seed was destroyed from Hesebon even to Daibon. And against Moab their wives rekindled a fire.
NUM 21:31 And when Israel had taken possession of all the cities of the Amorites:
NUM 21:32 Moses sent to view Jazer, and they took it, and all the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
NUM 21:33 Then they turned and went up by the way of Basan. And when Og king of Basan came out to meet them, he and all his people, for battle at Adraim
NUM 21:34 the Lord said to Moses, Be not afraid of him; for into thy hands I will deliver him, and all his people, and all his land; And thou shalt do to him, as thou hast done to Seon, the king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Hesebon.
NUM 21:35 So he smote him, and his sons,, and all his people, until there was not one left to be taken alive. And they took possession of their land.
NUM 22:1 When the Israelites had removed, and pitched their tents on the west of Moab, along the Jordan, over against Jericho;
NUM 22:2 and Balak, son of Sepphor, had seen all that Israel had done to the Amorites,
NUM 22:3 though Moab was exceedingly afraid of the people because they were numerous, yet Moab was incensed at the sight of the Israelites,
NUM 22:4 and said to the Senate of Madiam, Now will this congregation lick up all around us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. Now Balak, son of Sepphor, was at that time king of Moab,
NUM 22:5 he therefore had sent messengers to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pathoura, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to invite him to come to him, saying, Behold there is a people come out of Egypt; and lo! they have covered the face of this land, and are settled down near me.
NUM 22:6 Now therefore come, curse for me this people; for they are stronger than I. Perhaps I may be able to smite some of them, and drive them out of this land: for I know that they whom thou blessest are blessed, and they whom thou cursest are cursed.
NUM 22:7 So the ambassadors of Moab, and the ambassadors of Madiam, went with the rewards of divination in their hands, and when they came to Balaam, and rehearsed to him the words of Balak,
NUM 22:8 he said to them, Tarry here this night, and I will give you an answer according to what the Lord shall say to me. So the chiefs of Moab tarried with Balaam.
NUM 22:9 And God came to Balaam, and said to him, What would these men with thee?
NUM 22:10 And Balaam said to God, Balak son of Sepphor, king of Moab, hath sent them to me, saying,
NUM 22:11 Behold there is a people come out of Egypt, who have covered the face of this land, and they are settled down near me; now therefore come and curse them for me; perhaps I may be able to smite them, and drive them out of this land.
NUM 22:12 Thereupon God said to Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them, nor curse that people, for they are blessed.
NUM 22:13 So when Balaam arose in the morning, he said to the chiefs of Balak, Return speedily to your Lord, for God doth not permit me to go with you.
NUM 22:14 And the chiefs of Moab arose, and went to Balak, and said to him, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
NUM 22:15 Then Balak sent again other princes, more in number, and of greater dignity than them,
NUM 22:16 and they went to Balaam and said to him, Thus saith Balak, the son of Sepphor, I entreat thee delay not to come to me,
NUM 22:17 for I will promote thee to great honour, and do for thee whatever thou sayest; therefore come, curse this people for me.
NUM 22:18 In reply to which Balaam said to the princes of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot transgress the word of the Lord God, to do any thing, small or great, of my own mere will.
NUM 22:19 Now therefore tarry you also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will further say to me.
NUM 22:20 And God came to Balaam by night, and said to him, If these men come to call thee, arise and go with them: but what I say to thee, that thou shalt do.
NUM 22:21 Whereupon Balaam arose in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
NUM 22:22 And God was angry, because he went of himself to him; and the angel of God arose to stop him on the way. Now he was mounted on his ass, and had two servants with him.
NUM 22:23 And when the ass saw the angel of God standing opposite, in the way, with a drawn sword in his hand, the ass turned aside out of the way into the field; at which he struck the ass with his staff, to turn her into the road.
NUM 22:24 Then the angel of God took a station between the rows of the vines, there being a hedge on this side, and a hedge on that.
NUM 22:25 And when the ass saw the angel of God, she threw herself against the wall, and bruised Balaam's foot against the wall. Where upon he struck her again.
NUM 22:26 Then the angel of God again retired, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no turning, to the right, or to the left.
NUM 22:27 And when the ass saw the angel of God, she lay down under Balaam; at which Balaam was in flamed with wrath, and gave the ass a severe blow with the staff.
NUM 22:28 Thereupon God opened the mouth of the ass, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to thee that thou hast corrected me this third time?
NUM 22:29 And Balaam said to the ass, because thou hast mocked me, and had I a sword in my hand I should now have run it through thee.
NUM 22:30 And the ass said to Balaam, Am I not the ass on which thou hast ridden from thy youth even to this day? Did I ever through stubbornness, do such a thing as this to thee. And he said, No.
NUM 22:31 Then God opened the eyes of Balaam; and when he saw the angel of the Lord standing opposite, in the way, with a drawn sword in his hand, he bowed down, and fell flat on his face.
NUM 22:32 And the angel of God said to him, Why didst thou strike thy ass three times? Behold I came out to stop thee, because thy journey is not seemly in my sight,
NUM 22:33 and the ass, seeing me, turned aside from me these three times. And had she not turned aside from me I should now have killed thee; but I would have preserved her alive.
NUM 22:34 Then Balaam said to the angel of the Lord, I have sinned inadvertently; for I did not know that thou stoodest in the way against me. Now therefore, if it is not agreeable to thee, I will turn back.
NUM 22:35 And the angel of God said to Balaam, Go with these men; but whatever word I speak to thee be careful to deliver that. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
NUM 22:36 And when Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him, to a city of Moab, which is on Arnon, which is a part of the boundary.
NUM 22:37 And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not send for thee? Why then didst thou not come to me? Am not I able to promote thee to honour?
NUM 22:38 And Balaam said to Balak, Behold now I am come to thee, shall I be able to say any thing? Whatever word God shall put in my mouth; that I will speak.
NUM 22:39 So Balaam went with Balak, and when they came to the cities of Sheepcots,
NUM 22:40 Balak sacrificed sheep, and young bulls, and sent them to Balaam, and the princes with him.
NUM 22:41 And early next morning Balak took Balaam, and led him up to the top of the pillar of Baal, and from it shewed him some part of the people.
NUM 23:1 Whereupon Balaam said to Balak, Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven young bulls, and seven rams.
NUM 23:2 And when Balak had done as Balaam had ordered him; and had offered a bull, and a ram, on each altar,
NUM 23:3 then Balaam said to Balak, Stand by thy sacrifice, and I will advance on. If God appear to me by any occurrence, whatever he shall shew me I will tell thee.
NUM 23:4 So Balak stood by his sacrifice. And Balaam went to inquire of God: and as he was going straight forward, God appeared to Balaam: And Balaam said to him, I have prepared seven altars, and offered a young bull, and a ram, on each altar.
NUM 23:5 And God put a word in the mouth of Balaam, and said, Return to Balak, and thus thou shalt say.
NUM 23:6 So he returned to Balak. Now he was standing by his whole burnt offerings, and all the princes of Moab with him;
NUM 23:7 And a spirit of God came upon Balaam, and he took up his parable, and said, I am called from Mesopotamia by Balak; By the king of Moab from the mountains of the east, Come, saith he, Curse Jacob for me, And, come, for me devote Israel.
NUM 23:8 How can I curse him, whom the Lord doth nut curse? Or how devote him whom God devoteth not?
NUM 23:9 For from the top of mountains I can see him; Even from hills I can observe him, Behold he shall dwell, as a people by themselves, And shall not be reckoned among the nations.
NUM 23:10 Who hath accurately scanned the seed of Jacob? Who can count the communities of Israel? May my soul depart among the souls of the righteous! And my offspring be as the seed of these!
NUM 23:11 At this Balak said to Balaam, What hast thou done to me? I sent for thee to curse my enemies, and behold thou hast pronounced a blessing.
NUM 23:12 And Balaam said to Balak, Must I not be careful to speak what God hath put in my mouth?
NUM 23:13 Then Balak said to him, Come with me to yet another place, from which thou shalt not have a full view of them. Thou shalt see only a part of them, and not view them all; and curse them for me from that place.
NUM 23:14 So he took him to a watch tower of the field on the top of a craggy cliff, and built there seven altars. And when he had offered a bull, and a ram, on each altar,
NUM 23:15 Balaam said to Balak, Stand by thy sacrifice, and I will advance on, to inquire of God.
NUM 23:16 And God met Balaam and put a word in his mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
NUM 23:17 So he returned to him. Now he was standing by his whole burnt offering, and all the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, What hath the Lord spoken?
NUM 23:18 Whereupon he took up his parable, and said, Stand up Balak and hear; Listen attentively as a witness, thou son of Sepphor!
NUM 23:19 God is not like a man to be deceived; Nor like a son of man to be threatened. When he hath spoken, will he not perform? When he shall speak, will he not stand to it?
NUM 23:20 Behold I am constrained to bless! Bless I will. Indeed I cannot avoid it.
NUM 23:21 There shall be no calamity in Jacob; Nor shall misery be seen in Israel. The Lord their God is with them; The glories of princes are among them.
NUM 23:22 The God who hath brought them out of Egypt, Is to them like the glory of a unicorn.
NUM 23:23 For there is no augury used by Jacob; Nor divination among Israel. In due season it shall be told by Jacob, And to Israel, what God will execute.
NUM 23:24 Behold the people will rouse like a young lion; And, like an old lion, exult with pride. They will not go to rest till they devour prey; Until they have drunk the blood of the slain.
NUM 23:25 Upon this Balak said to Balaam, Thou shalt neither with curses, curse them for me; nor shalt thou with blessings bless them.
NUM 23:26 In reply to which Balaam said to Balak, Did I not tell thee saying, Whatever God shall speak, that I must do.
NUM 23:27 Then Balak said to Balaam, Come let me take thee to another place, that, if it please God, thou mayst curse them for me from it.
NUM 23:28 So Balak took Balaam to the top of Phogor, which extendeth into the wilderness.
NUM 23:29 And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven young bulls, and seven rams.
NUM 23:30 And when Balak had done as Balaam ordered him, and had offered a bull, and a ram, on every altar,
NUM 24:1 Balaam, seeing that it was good in the sight of the Lord to bless Israel, did not go, as was customary with him, to look for omens; but turned his face towards the wilderness.
NUM 24:2 And when Balaam raised his eyes, and saw Israel encamped by tribes, a spirit of God came upon him, and he took up his parable, and said,
NUM 24:3 Balaam son of Beor saith; The man who seeth according to truth saith:
NUM 24:4 It is the saying of him, who hath heard the oracles of the Almighty; Who in sleep hath seen a vision of God; whose eyes were opened.
NUM 24:5 How beautiful are thy houses, Jacob! Thy tents, Israel!
NUM 24:6 Like shady forests, and like gardens by a river! And like tents which the Lord hath pitched! And like cedars by streams of water.
NUM 24:7 There shall come forth a man from his seed, And he shall rule over many nations: And a kingdom greater than Gog's shall be raised up; And his kingdom shall be enlarged
NUM 24:8 God hath led him out of Egypt; His glory is like that of the unicorn; He will eat up the nations of his enemies; And he will exhaust their fatness, And pierce his enemy with his darts.
NUM 24:9 Couching down, he is gone to rest, like a lion; Yes like a young lion; who dare rouse him? Blessed are they who bless thee, And they who curse thee are already cursed.
NUM 24:10 At this Balak was inflamed with wrath against Balaam, and clapped his hands. And Balak said to Balaam, I sent for thee to curse my enemy, and behold thou hast blessed them a third time.
NUM 24:11 Now therefore flee to thy own place. I thought to promote thee to honour. But the Lord hath now deprived thee of that glory.
NUM 24:12 Whereupon Balaam said to Balak, Did I not tell thy messengers whom thou sentest to me,
NUM 24:13 If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot transgress the word of the Lord, to do either good or evil, of my own mere will. Whatever God may order that I will speak.
NUM 24:14 And now, behold, I am quickly to return to my own place: come, let me inform thee what this people will do to thy people, in the latter days.
NUM 24:15 Then taking up his parable, he said, Balaam son of Beor saith; It is the saying of a man who is a true seer,
NUM 24:16 Who heareth the oracles of God, And hath knowledge from the Most High; Who in sleep hath seen a vision of God, and whose eyes were opened.
NUM 24:17 I can point to him, though he is not now; I hail him happy tho" he is not near. A star will arise out of Jacob; There shall rise up a man out of Israel, And he will smite the princes of Moab, And plunder all the sons of Seth:
NUM 24:18 And Edom shall be an inheritance, And Esau, his enemy, shall be a heritage. Though Israel hath done valiantly;
NUM 24:19 Yet one shall be raised up out of Jacob, Who will destroy him who escaped from a city.
NUM 24:20 Then having taken a view of Amalek he took up his parable and said, Amalek is the head of nations; But their seed shall be destroyed.
NUM 24:21 Then having taken a view of the Kenite, he took up his parable and said, Strong is thy dwelling place. But though thou hast built thy nest upon a rock;
NUM 24:22 And though Beor hath crafty chickens; The Assyrians will captivate thee.
NUM 24:23 Then looking at Og he took up his parable and said, Oh! Who can live when God will order such things!
NUM 24:24 For bands of Kitians will issue forth, And afflict Assur, and afflict Hebrews: And they themselves shall likewise be destroyed.
NUM 24:25 Then Balaam arose, and went away, with a view to return to his own place, and Balak repaired home.

NUM 27:20 him. And thou shalt put some of thy glory on him, that the
NUM 27:21 children of Israel may hearken to him. And he shall stand before Eleazar, the priest, and they shall ask him the determination of the manifestations before the Lord. And at his command they shall go out; and at his command he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation, shall come in.
NUM 27:22 So Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and having taken Joshua, he set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation,
NUM 27:23 and laid his hands on him, and made him his associate, as the Lord commanded Moses.
NUM 28:1 Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 28:2 Give a charge to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, You shall observe to bring me my gifts, my oblations, my homage offerings for a smell of fragrance at my festivals.
NUM 28:3 Moreover thou shalt say to them, These are the homage offerings which you shall present to the Lord; two lambs, of the first year, with 4 out blemish, every day, for a continual whole burnt offering;
NUM 28:4 the one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning, and the other in the evening;
NUM 28:5 and for a sacrifice of flour, thou shalt offer the tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed up with the quarter of an hin of oil.
NUM 28:6 It is the continual whole burnt offering, which was instituted at mount Sina, for a smell of fragrance for the Lord:
NUM 28:7 and for the libation thereof, thou shalt offer, with the first lamb, a quarter of an hin of wine. In the holy place thou shalt pour out as a libation the choicest wine to the Lord.
NUM 28:8 And towards evening thou shalt offer the other lamb, with the like sacrifice, and the like libation; for a smell of fragrance for the Lord.
NUM 28:9 And on the day of the sabbaths, you shall bring two lambs of the first year, without blemish, and two tenths of fine flour mixed up with oil, for a sacrifice, together with a libation,
NUM 28:10 as the sabbath whole burnt offering, for every sabbath, over and above the continual whole burnt offering with its libation.
NUM 28:11 And at the new moons you shall offer a whole burnt offering to the Lord, two young bulls from the herd, one ram, seven lambs, of the first year, without blemish,
NUM 28:12 three tenths of fine flour, mixed up with oil, for each bull, and two tenths of fine flour, mixed up with oil, for the ram,
NUM 28:13 and a tenth of fine flour, mixed up with oil, for every lamb, as a sacrifice for a smell of fragrance; an homage offering for the Lord:
NUM 28:14 and their libation shall be, the half of an hin of wine for each bull; and the third of an hin for the ram; and the fourth of an hin for every lamb. This shall be the whole burnt offering, month after month, for all the months of the year;
NUM 28:15 Also a kid of the goats, for a sin offering. This, with its libation, shall be offered to the Lord, over and above the continual whole burnt offering.
NUM 28:16 And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, shall be the passover to the Lord,
NUM 28:17 and on the fifteenth day of the month shall commence the festival thereof. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
NUM 28:18 Now, this first day shall be solemnly set apart for you. You shall not do any kind of sacrificial service;
NUM 28:19 but you shall bring for whole burnt offerings; for an offering of homage to the Lord, two young bulls from the herd, one ram, seven lambs of the first year. You must see that they are without blemish.
NUM 28:20 And their sacrifice shall be fine flour, mixed up with oil, three tenths for each bull, and two tent! is for the ram,
NUM 28:21 and thou shalt prepare a tenth for every one of the seven lambs;
NUM 28:22 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
NUM 28:23 over and above the whole burnt offering which is to be made every morning, and which is a continual whole burnt offering.
NUM 28:24 After this manner you shall make daily offerings, during the seven days, as a gift; an offering of homage, for a smell of fragrance, to the Lord: Over and above the continual whole burnt offering, thou shalt offer it with its libation.
NUM 28:25 And the seventh of these days shall be solemnly set apart for you. On it you shall do no sacrificial work.
NUM 28:26 And on the day of new things when you bring for the Lord the new sacrifice of the weeks, there shall be a solemn festival for you. You shall not do any kind of sacrificial service;
NUM 28:27 but you shall bring, as whole burnt offerings, for a smell of fragrance to the Lord, two young bulls from the herd, one ram, seven lambs, of the first year, without blemish,
NUM 28:28 with their sacrifice of fine flour mixed up with oil; three tenths for each bull, and two tenths for the ram,
NUM 28:29 and one tenth for every of the seven lambs;
NUM 28:30 and one kid of the goats, for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
NUM 28:31 Over and above the continual whole burnt offering, you shall offer me the sacrifice of these [and see that they be without blemish] together with the libations thereof.
NUM 29:1 And in the seventh month on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn festival for you. You shall do no sacrificial work. It shall be to you a day of alarm.
NUM 29:2 And you shall offer as whole burnt offerings; for a smell of fragrance to the Lord, one young bull from the herd; one ram, seven lambs, of the first year, without blemish,
NUM 29:3 with their sacrifice; fine flour mixed up with oil; three tenths for the bull, and two tenths for the ram,
NUM 29:4 and a tenth for every one of the seven lambs;
NUM 29:5 and a kid of the goats, for a sin offering, to make atonement for you,

NUM 29:11 and a kid of the goats, for a sin offering, to make atonement for you, over and above the sin offering of the atonement, and the continual whole burnt offering. And the sacrifice of this, and the libation of this, shall be according to what is prescribed, for a smell of fragrance; an offering of homage to the Lord.
NUM 29:12 And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, there shall be a solemn festival set apart for you. You shall do no sacrificial work. And you shall celebrate this festival to the Lord seven days.

NUM 29:18 with their sacrifice and their libation, for the bulls and the rams, and the lambs, according to their number agreeably to what is prescribed for them;
NUM 29:19 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.
NUM 29:20 And on the third day, eleven young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year, without blemish,
NUM 29:21 with their sacrifices and their libations, for the bulls, and the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, agreeably to what is prescribed for them;
NUM 29:22 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.
NUM 29:23 And on the fourth day, ten young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year, without blemish,
NUM 29:24 with their sacrifices and their libations, for the bulls and the rams, and the lambs, according to the number of them agreeably to what is prescribed for them;
NUM 29:25 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.

NUM 29:28 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.

NUM 29:30 with their sacrifices and their libations; for the bulls, and the rams, and the lambs, according to the number of them agreeably to what is prescribed for them;
NUM 29:31 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.

NUM 29:33 with their sacrifices and their libations; for the bulls and the rams, and the lambs, according to the number of them agreeably to what is prescribed for them;
NUM 29:34 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.
NUM 29:35 And on the eighth day, you shall close the festival. On that day you shall not do any kind of sacrificial work.

NUM 29:37 with their sacrifices and their libations, for the bull, and the ram, and the lambs, according to the number of them, agreeably to what is prescribed for them;
NUM 29:38 and a kid of the goats for a sin offering, over and above the continual whole burnt offerings, with their sacrifices and their libations.
NUM 29:39 These you shall offer to the Lord at your festivals, over and above your vows, and your free will offerings, and your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your libations, and your offerings of thanksgiving.
NUM 29:40 So Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded him.
NUM 30:1 Moreover Moses spoke to the chiefs of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.
NUM 30:2 If any man vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath, or bind himself with a solemn promise concerning his soul, he shall not break his word. Whatever hath proceeded from his mouth he shall do.
NUM 30:3 And if a woman vow to the Lord, or bind herself with a solemn promise, in her father's house, in her youth;
NUM 30:4 and her father hear her vows, and her promises with which she hath bound her soul, and hold his peace at her; all her vows, and all the promises with which she bound her soul, shall stand.
NUM 30:5 They shall be binding on her. But if her father expressly disapprove on the day he heareth her vows and the promises, with which she hath bound her soul, they shall not stand. And the Lord will acquit her because her father hath disallowed her.
NUM 30:6 And if she be married, and vows be upon her; according to the opening of her lips; with what promises soever she may have bound her soul,
NUM 30:7 if her husband shall hear, and hold his peace at her on the day when he heareth, so shall all her vows stand, and the promises shall stand with which she hath bound her soul.
NUM 30:8 But if her husband expressly disallow her on the day when he shall hear, none of her vows, and none of the obligations with which she hath bound her soul, shall be binding, because her husband disallowed her. And the Lord will acquit her.
NUM 30:9 But the vows of a widow, or of one divorced; whatever vows she may have made to bind her soul, shall stand against her.
NUM 30:10 And if her vow, or the obligation with which she bound her soul with an oath, be made in her husband's house;
NUM 30:11 and her husband shall hear, and hold his peace at her, and not disallow her; all her vows and all her promises with which she hath bound her soul shall stand against her.
NUM 30:12 But if her husband on the day when he heareth, actually disannul all that may have proceeded out of her lips, of what nature soever her vows may be, or the obligations with which she bound her soul, they shall not be binding on her. Her husband hath made them void, and the Lord will acquit her.
NUM 30:13 Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband may establish, or make void.
NUM 30:14 And if lie hold his peace at her, day after day, he shall establish upon her all her vows, and confirm the obligations upon her, because he held his peace at her on the day he heard them.
NUM 30:15 And if her husband disannul them after the day when he heard, he shall bear the sin of this.
NUM 30:16 These are the judgments which the Lord gave in charge to Moses, between a husband and wife, and between a father and a daughter in her youth, in her father's house.
NUM 31:1 Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 31:2 Avenge the cause of the children of Israel on the Madianites, and afterward thou shalt be gathered to thy people.
NUM 31:3 Whereupon Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm men from among you and array them before the Lord, against Madian, to pour vengeance from the Lord on Madian;
NUM 31:4 a thousand from every tribe. You shall send them out of all the tribes to be drawn up in array.
NUM 31:5 So out of the thousands of Israel they numbered a thousand from a tribe; twelve thousand. They were armed for close engagement.
NUM 31:6 And Moses sent these; a thousand from every tribe; and with the army composed of them, Phineas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, with the holy instruments; the trumpets for sounding a charge, in their hands.
NUM 31:7 And they drew up in array against Madian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and slew every male;
NUM 31:8 and in the slaughter they slew the kings of Madian, Evin, and Rokon, and Sur, and Ur,  and Robok, the five kings of Madian. They slew also Balaam, son of Beor, with the sword among their slain.
NUM 31:9 And having taken for a prey the women of the Madianites, and their furniture, and their cattle, and all their goods, and spoiled their army,
NUM 31:10 and burned all their cities in which they dwelt, and all their sheepcots, with fire,
NUM 31:11 and taken all the prey thereof, and all the spoils thereof, both of man and beast,
NUM 31:12 they brought to Moses, and Eleazar, and to all the Israelites, the captives, and the spoils, and the prey, to the camp at Araboth-Moab, on the Jordan, over against Jericho.
NUM 31:13 And when Moses went out, accompanied with Eleazar the priest, and all the chiefs of the congregation, to meet them without the camp,
NUM 31:14 Moses was angry at the officers of the army; at the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, who came from the war.
NUM 31:15 And Moses said to them, Why have you saved all the women alive?
NUM 31:16 For they, by the direction of Balaam, were the cause of Israel's apostatizing, and transgressing the commands of the Lord, for the sake of Phogor: and there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord.
NUM 31:17 Now therefore kill every male among the captives. Kill also every woman, who hath lain with man.
NUM 31:18 But save alive, for yourselves, every captive among the women, who hath not known a man.
NUM 31:19 And abide without the camp seven days. Every one who hath slain, or who hath touched one slain, must be purified on the third day, and on the seventh day, including yourselves and your captives.
NUM 31:20 And you must purify every covering, and every vessel made of skin, and every hair cloth, and every utensil of wood.
NUM 31:21 Then Eleazar the priest, said to the men of the army, who came from the war, This is the ordinance of the law, which the Lord gave in charge to Moses,
NUM 31:22 Besides the gold, and the silver, and the brass, and the iron, and the lead, and the tin,
NUM 31:23 every thing which can pass through fire must be purified by fire; but the rest are to be purified by the water of purification only. Whatever cannot pass through fire must pass through water.
NUM 31:24 And on the seventh day you must wash your clothes, and you shall be clean; and after that you may come into the camp.
NUM 31:25 Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 31:26 Take the sum of the captivated prey both of man and beast; thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chiefs of the patriarchal houses of the congregation.
NUM 31:27 And you shall divide the prey between the warriors who went to battle, and the whole congregation.
NUM 31:28 And you shall set apart as a tribute to the Lord, from the warriors who went out to battle, one in five hundred from the captives, and from the beasts, namely, the cattle, and the sheep, and the asses.
NUM 31:29 These you shall take from their half, and give to Eleazar the priest, as a portion set apart for the Lord.
NUM 31:30 And from the children of Israel's half thou shalt take one in fifty of the captives, and of the cattle, and the sheep, and the asses; of all these beasts. And these thou shalt give to the Levites, who keep the watch at the tabernacle of the Lord.
NUM 31:31 So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
NUM 31:32 And the whole amount of the booty which the warriors had taken, was, of sheep six hundred and seventy five thousand;
NUM 31:33 of cattle seventy two thousand,
NUM 31:34 and sixty one thousand asses;
NUM 31:35 and of the human species, namely, of the women who had not known man, all the souls were thirty two thousand.
NUM 31:36 So that the half which was the share of those who went to war, was, from the number of sheep, three hundred and thirty seven thousand five hundred;
NUM 31:37 of which the tribute for the Lord was six hundred and seventy five;
NUM 31:38 and of cattle, thirty six thousand, of which the tribute for the Lord was seventy two;
NUM 31:39 and of asses, thirty thousand five hundred, of which the tribute for the Lord was sixty one;
NUM 31:40 and the human beings were sixteen thousand, of whom the tribute for the Lord was thirty two.
NUM 31:41 And this tribute for the Lord, this dedication made to God by setting it apart, Moses gave to Eleazar the priest as the Lord commanded Moses.
NUM 31:42 And from the half belonging to the children of Israel, between whom and the warriors Moses had made the division;
NUM 31:43 now the congregation's half was three hundred and thirty seven thousand five hundred sheep,
NUM 31:44 thirty six thousand cattle,
NUM 31:45 thirty thousand five hundred asses,
NUM 31:46 and of human beings, sixteen thousand;
NUM 31:47 from this half, belonging to the children of Israel, Moses took one in fifty, of man and beast, and gave them to the Levites, who kept the watch at the tabernacle of the testimony, as the Lord commanded Moses.
NUM 31:48 Then all the officers over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds,
NUM 31:49 came to Moses, and said to him, Thy servants have taken an account of all the warriors who were with us, and there is not one of them missing.
NUM 31:50 We have therefore brought, as every man chanced to find a jewel of gold, either a necklace, or a bracelet, or a ring, or an ornament for the right arm, or a chain, to make atonement for us before the Lord.
NUM 31:51 So Moses and Eleazar the priest, received from them the gold; all the wrought jewels;
NUM 31:52 and the whole amount of the gold, the dedication which they set apart for the Lord, was, sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels. This they received from the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds.
NUM 31:53 Of the spoil, which the warriors made every man for himself,
NUM 31:54 Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the testimony, to be a memorial of the children of Israel before the Lord.
NUM 32:1 Now the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, had a great multitude of cattle, and having taken a view of the country of Jazer, and the region of Galaad, and seen that it was a place fit for stock,
NUM 32:2 the Reubenites and the Gadites came to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the chiefs of the congregation and said,
NUM 32:3 Ataroth, and Daibon, and Jazer, and Namra, and Esebon, and Eleale, and Sebama, and Nabo, and Baian,
NUM 32:4 the land which the Lord delivered up before the children of Israel, is a land fit for raising stock, and thy servants have cattle;
NUM 32:5 if therefore, said they, we have found favour in thy sight, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession, and cause us not to cross the Jordan.
NUM 32:6 Whereupon Moses said to the Gadites and the Reubenites, Must your brethren go to war, and you sit still here?
NUM 32:7 Besides, why do you divert the thoughts of the Israelites from crossing over into the land which the Lord giveth them?
NUM 32:8 Did not your fathers do so, when I sent them from Kades-Barne to view the land?
NUM 32:9 When they had passed through the valley of grapes, and viewed the land, they discouraged the heart of the Israelites from going to the land which the Lord gave them;
NUM 32:10 and the anger of the Lord was kindled that day, and he sware saying,
NUM 32:11 These men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upwards, who know good and evil, shall not see the land, which I with an oath promised to Abraham, and Isaak, and Jacob; [for they have not followed me]
NUM 32:12 save Chaleb, son of Jephonne, who separated himself from them, and Joshua, son of Nave, because they followed the Lord.
NUM 32:13 So the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he led them about in the wilderness forty years, until all that generation, who had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.
NUM 32:14 Behold you are risen up in your fathers' stead, a set of sinful men, to augment the wrath of the Lord against Israel.
NUM 32:15 For by turning away from him, to cause him to leave you still in the wilderness, you will transgress against the whole congregation.
NUM 32:16 Upon this they came near to him, and said, We will build sheepcots here for our cattle, and cities for our families,
NUM 32:17 but we ourselves, completely armed, will march in the van before the children of Israel, until we bring them to their place. Our families indeed must dwell in walled cities, because of the inhabitants of the land,
NUM 32:18 that we may not be under a necessity of returning to our houses, until the children of Israel are parcelled out, every one in his possession.
NUM 32:19 Moreover we will not take a share with them of the land beyond the river Jordan, because we have got our share on the eastern side of the Jordan.
NUM 32:20 Then Moses said to them, If you will act agreeably to what you say; if you will arm yourselves for battle before the Lord,
NUM 32:21 and every one, completely armed, will cross the Jordan before the Lord, until his enemy be crushed before him,
NUM 32:22 and the land subdued before the Lord, after this you shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and acquitted by Israel, and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
NUM 32:23 But if you do not act in this manner, you will sin against the Lord, and you shall be sensible of your sin, when evils overtake you.
NUM 32:24 Build therefore cities for your families, and sheepcots for your cattle, and perform what hath proceeded out of your mouth.
NUM 32:25 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad spake to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as our Lord commandeth;
NUM 32:26 our families, and our wives, and our cattle, shall remain in the cities of Galaad;
NUM 32:27 but we thy servants will cross over, all armed, and arrayed for battle before the Lord, as our lord saith.
NUM 32:28 Then Moses convened with them Eleazar the priest, and Joshua, son of Nave, and the chiefs of the patriarchal houses of the tribes of Israel,
NUM 32:29 and said to them, If the Reubenites and the Gadites cross the Jordan with you, every one armed for battle before the Lord, when you shall have subdued the land before you, you shall give them the land of Galaad for a possession.
NUM 32:30 But if they decline to cross with you, armed for battle before the Lord; you shall drive before you their families, and their wives, and their cattle, into the land of Chanaan, and they shall have a portion with you in the land of Chanaan.
NUM 32:31 And the Reubenites and the Gadites answered, saying, All that our lord saith to his servants we will do.
NUM 32:32 We will cross over, completely armed before the Lord, into the land of Chanaan, and you shall give us our possession on this side of the Jordan.
NUM 32:33 So Moses gave them, namely, to the Gadites and the Reubenites, and to the half of the tribe of Manasses, one of the sons of Joseph, the kingdom of Seon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Basan, the land and the cities, with the boundaries thereof, even the cities of the land round about.
NUM 32:34 And the Gadites rebuilt Daibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
NUM 32:35 and Sophar, and Jazer, and raised these, namely,
NUM 32:36 Namram and Baithara, fenced cities, and folds for sheep.
NUM 32:37 And the Reubenites rebuilt Esebon, and Eleale, and Kariatham,
NUM 32:38 and Beelmeon, which they enclosed all around, and Sebama; and they named the cities which they rebuilt after their own names.
NUM 32:39 Now a descendant of Machir, son of Manasses, had gone to Galaad, and taken it, and destroyed the Amorite who dwelt there.
NUM 32:40 So Moses gave Galaad to the community of Machir, son of Manasses, and they dwelt there.
NUM 32:41 And Jair, of the tribe of Manasses, went and took their sheepcots, and called them the sheepcots of Jair.
NUM 32:42 And Nabau went and took Kaath, and its villages, and called them Naboth after his own name.
NUM 33:1 Now these are the encampments of the Israelites. When they came out of the land of Egypt, with their army, by the ministry of Moses and Aaron,
NUM 33:2 Moses committed to writing their removals and encampments, by the command of the Lord, and these are the encampments of their march.
NUM 33:3 They removed from Ramesses, in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the next morning after the passover, the Israelites came out with a high hand, in the sight of all the Egyptians,
NUM 33:4 while they were burying their dead; all those whom the Lord had smitten; even all the first born of the land of Egypt. When the Lord had executed vengeance on their gods,
NUM 33:5 the children of Israel, removing from Ramesses, encamped at Sokchoth.
NUM 33:6 And removing from Sokchoth, they encamped at Bouthan, which is a part of the wilderness.
NUM 33:7 And they removed from Bouthan, and encamped at the mouth of Eirath, which is over against Beelsepphon. They encamped also over against Magdolus.
NUM 33:8 And they removed from over against Eirath, and crossed through the midst of the sea, into the wilderness, and having marched three days' journey through the wilderness, they encamped at Bitterness.
NUM 33:9 And they removed from Bitterness, and came to Ailam. Now at Ailam there were twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm trees. So they encamped there by the water.
NUM 33:10 And they removed from Ailam, and encamped by the Red sea.
NUM 33:11 And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
NUM 33:12 And they removed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped at Raphaka.
NUM 33:13 And they removed from Raphaka, and encamped at Ailus.
NUM 33:14 And they removed from Ailus and encamped at Raphadin, where there was no water for the people to drink.
NUM 33:15 And they removed from Raphadin, and encamped in the wilderness of Sina.
NUM 33:16 And they removed from the wilderness of Sina, and encamped at The monuments of longing desire.
NUM 33:17 And they removed from The monuments of longing desire, and encamped at Aseroth.
NUM 33:18 And they removed from Aseroth, and encamped at Rathama.
NUM 33:19 And they removed from Rathama, and encamped at Remmon-Phares.
NUM 33:20 And they removed from Remmon-Phares, and encamped at Lebona.
NUM 33:21 And they removed from Lebona, and encamped at Ressan.
NUM 33:22 And they removed from Ressan, and encamped at Makellath.
NUM 33:23 And they removed from Makellath, and encamped at Saphan.
NUM 33:24 And they removed from Saphan, and encamped at Charadath.
NUM 33:25 And they removed from Charadath, and encamped at Makeloth.
NUM 33:26 And they removed from Makeloth, and encamped at Kataath.
NUM 33:27 And they removed from Kataath, and encamped at Tarath.
NUM 33:28 And they removed from Tarath, and encamped at Mathekka.
NUM 33:29 And they removed from Mathekka, and encamped at Selmona.
NUM 33:30 And they removed from Selmona, and encamped at Masuruth.
NUM 33:31 And they removed from Masuruth, and encamped at Banaia.
NUM 33:32 And they removed from Banaia, and encamped at the mountain of Gadgad.
NUM 33:33 And they removed from the mountain of Gadgad, and encamped at Etebatha.
NUM 33:34 And they removed from Etebatha, and encamped at Ebrona.
NUM 33:35 And they removed from Ebrona, and encamped at Gasion-Gaber.
NUM 33:36 And they removed from Gasion-Gaber, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin. And they removed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in the wilderness of Pharan, this is Kades.
NUM 33:37 And they removed from Kades, and encamped at Or, the mountain bordering on the land of Edom.
NUM 33:38 And Aaron the priest went up at the command of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year of the children of Israel's coming out of Egypt, in the fifth month, the first day of the month.
NUM 33:39 And Aaron was a hundred and twenty three years old when he died at mount Or.
NUM 33:40 And the Chananite king of Arad, whose fixed abode was in the land of Chanaan, received intelligence when the children of Israel were marching in.
NUM 33:41 And they removed from mount Or, and encamped at Selmona.
NUM 33:42 And they removed from Selmona, and encamped at Phino.
NUM 33:43 And they removed from Phino, and encamped at Oboth.
NUM 33:44 And they removed from Oboth, and encamped at Gai, on the borders of Moab.
NUM 33:45 And they removed from Gai, and encamped at Daibon-gad.
NUM 33:46 And they removed from Daibon-gad, and encamped at Gelmon-deblathaim.
NUM 33:47 And they removed from Gelmon-deblathaim, and encamped on the mountains Abarim, over against Nabo.
NUM 33:48 And they removed from the mountains Abarim, and encamped on the west of Moab, by the Jordan, opposite to Jericho.
NUM 33:49 And when they were encamped on the Jordan, from Aisimoth to Belsa, which is on the west of Moab,
NUM 33:50 the Lord spoke to Moses on the west of Moab by the Jordan, in front of Jericho, saying,
NUM 33:51 Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, You are now going to cross the Jordan into the land of Chanaan.
NUM 33:52 You shall destroy all those who dwell in that land, from before you, and demolish their obelisks, and utterly destroy their molten images, and all their pillars you shall demolish. And when you have destroyed all the inhabitants of that land,
NUM 33:53 you shall dwell therein; for I have given you their land by lot,
NUM 33:54 and you shall divide their land, by lot, among your tribes. To those who are more numerous you shall give a larger possession; and to those who are fewer in number you shall give a smaller possession. On whatever place any one's name falleth, there shall be his possession. According to the tribes of your families you shall possess it.
NUM 33:55 But if you do not destroy the inhabitants of the land from before you, it will come to pass, that those of them whom you shall leave, will be thorns in your eyes, and darts in your sides, and your mortal enemies in the land wherein you dwell.
NUM 33:56 And it will come to pass that I will deal with you as I determined to deal with them.
NUM 34:1 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
NUM 34:2 Give a charge to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, You are about to enter the land of Chanaan. This you shall have for an inheritance, even the whole land of Chanaan, with its borders.
NUM 34:3 And your southern border shall be, from the wilderness of Sin, until it joineth Edom.
NUM 34:4 And your boundaries on the south shall be, from a part of the salt sea on the east, and that boundary shall encompass you on the south, to the ascent of Acrabin, and shall pass on to Ennak, and run along south of Kades-barne and come to the sheepcot of Arad, and pass along by Asemona:
NUM 34:5 and from Asemona the boundary shall wind round along the brook of Egypt, and its termination shall be the sea.
NUM 34:6 Then you shall have the sea for a boundary. The great sea shall bound you: this shall be your western boundary.
NUM 34:7 And your boundary on the north shall be this; from the great sea you shall measure off for yourselves, along the range of mountains;
NUM 34:8 from mountain to mountain you shall measure off for yourselves: beginning at the bay of Emath, and extending along the border of Saradak,
NUM 34:9 the boundary shall come out along the borders of Dephrona and its termination shall be Arsenain. This shall be your northern boundary.
NUM 34:10 Then you shall measure off for yourselves the eastern boundary from Arsenain to Sepphamar; and from Sepphamar
NUM 34:11 the boundary shall run down to Bela, on the east of the fountains, then down along the borders of Bela, on the eastern side of the sea of Chenerith;
NUM 34:12 then down the Jordan; and its termination shall be the salt sea.
NUM 34:13 This shall be your land and these its boundaries round about. So Moses gave a charge to the Israelites saying, This is the land which you shall parcel out, by lot, in the manner the Lord hath commanded it to be given to the nine tribes, and to the half of the tribe of Manasses;
NUM 34:14 because the tribe of the Reubenites, and the tribe of the Gadites, according to the houses of their families, and the half of the tribe of the Manassites, have received their allotments.
NUM 34:15 two tribes, and the half of a tribe, have received their lots on the south east side of the Jordan, in front of Jericho.
NUM 34:16 Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 34:17 These are the names of the men who shall parcel out the land for you; Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nave,
NUM 34:18 And you shall take one chief of a tribe to divide the land among you by lot.
NUM 34:19 And these are the names of the men; Of the tribe of Judas, Chaleb son of Jephonne;
NUM 34:20 of the tribe of Symeon, Salamiel son of Samiud;
NUM 34:21 of the tribe of Benjamin, Eldad son of Chaslon;
NUM 34:22 of the tribe of Dan, chief Bakchir, son of Egli;
NUM 34:23 of the children of Joseph; of the tribe of the Manassites, chief Aniel, son of Suphi;
NUM 34:24 of the tribe of the Ephraimites, chief Kamuel, son of Sabathan;
NUM 34:25 of the tribe of Zabulon, chief Elisaphan, son of Pharnach;
NUM 34:26 of the tribe of Issachar, chief Phaltiel, son of Oza;
NUM 34:27 Of the tribe of Aser, chief Achior, son of Selemi;
NUM 34:28 of the tribe of Nephthaleim, chief Phadael, son of Jamiud.
NUM 34:29 To these the Lord gave it in charge to parcel out to the Israelites their allotments in the land of Chanaan.
NUM 35:1 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses, on the west of Moab, by the Jordan, over against Jericho, saying,
NUM 35:2 Command the children of Israel; and let them give the Levites, out of the lots of their possession, cities to dwell in. They shall also give the Levites the suburbs of these cities round about.
NUM 35:3 The cities shall be for them to dwell in; and the suburbs thereof shall be for their cattle, even for all their beasts.
NUM 35:4 Now the suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city, outwards, two thousand cubits all around.
NUM 35:5 Thou shalt therefore measure off, outwards from the city, on the east side two thousand cubits, on the south side two thousand cubits, on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits, and in the middle of this shall be your city;
NUM 35:6 and you shall give these suburbs of the cities with the cities, to the Levites. Six of the cities which you shall give shall be cities of refuge for the manslayer to flee to, and besides these you shall give forty two cities.
NUM 35:7 All the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be forty eight.
NUM 35:8 These cities with their suburbs, even the cities which you shall give, shall be from the possessions of the children of Israel. They shall give the Levites, out of their cities, many from those who have many, and few from them who have few; from every one according to the inheritance which they possess.
NUM 35:9 Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
NUM 35:10 Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, You are about to cross the Jordan into the land of Chanaan,
NUM 35:11 and you will set apart for yourselves cities, which shall be your places of refuge, to which the manslayer may flee. When any person killeth another unwittingly,
NUM 35:12 those cities will be places of refuge from the avenger of blood, that the manslayer may not die, until he stand before the congregation for trial.
NUM 35:13 Therefore, with regard to the cities which you shall give, six shall be your places of refuge;
NUM 35:14 three of these cities you shall give on this side of the Jordan, and three such cities you shall give in the land of Chanaan.
NUM 35:15 They shall be a refuge for the children of Israel, and for the proselyte, and the sojourner among you. These cities are to be places of refuge, to which every one may flee who hath smitten a person unawares.
NUM 35:16 But if he hath smitten him with an instrument of iron, and he die, he is a murderer; let the murderer be put to death.
NUM 35:17 And if he hath smitten him with a stone out of his hand, by which he might be killed, and he die; he is a murderer; let the murderer be put to death.
NUM 35:18 And if he hath smitten him with any instrument of wood out of his hand, by which he might be killed, and he die; he is a murderer; let the murderer be put to death.
NUM 35:19 The avenger of blood himself shall kill him. When he meeteth him he shall slay him.
NUM 35:20 And if, through hatred, he hath pushed him down, or thrown at him from ambush, any instrument whatever, and he die;
NUM 35:21 or if on account of an old grudge he hath smitten him with his hand, and he die; let him who smote be put to death: he is a murderer; let the murderer be put to death. The avenger of blood shall slay the murderer when he meeteth him.
NUM 35:22 But if on a sudden, not through malice aforethought, he hath pushed him down, or thrown any instrument at him, not from ambush,
NUM 35:23 nor with any stone by which he might be killed, or not seeing him, and it light upon him, and he die, and he was not his enemy, nor seeking to do him any injury,
